title: Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence
description:
Você é movido por dados, inovação e inteligência artificial?

Se você curte transformar informação em estratégia, desenhar soluções inteligentes e gerar impacto real nos resultados do negócio, essa vaga pode ser para você!

Venha fazer parte do time de UPXers e contribua com a nossa missão de tornar a internet um ambiente mais seguro para empresas e pessoas.

Como Especialista em IA e Business Intelligence , sua missão será liderar iniciativas que ampliem a eficiência do canal de vendas em cibersegurança por meio de automações, modelos preditivos e dashboards estratégicos — fornecendo à liderança insights precisos e acionáveis que impulsionem receita, performance e crescimento.

O desafio envolve combinar visão analítica, domínio técnico e mentalidade experimental para desenvolver soluções escaláveis e com alto impacto, sempre com uma abordagem data-driven, colaborativa e voltada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:


  • Selecionar tecnologias (LLMs, pipelines de dados, Power BI, Looker Studio) e integrá-las às plataformas de marketing, comunicação, vendas e processos de gestão estratégica;
  • Desenvolver frameworks analíticos que priorizem oportunidades de mercado, melhorem o score de leads e apoiem decisões de pricing e go-to-market;
  • Suportar os times com análise de dados, interpretando métricas e apresentando insights que orientem ações de marketing, comunicação e vendas;
  • Transformar processos manuais em fluxos autônomos de coleta, enriquecimento e ativação de dados — do first touch ao churn prevention;
  • Traduzir métricas em storytelling executivo, capacitar times internos e institucionalizar governança e qualidade dos dados;
  • Monitorar o desempenho de modelos e automações, ajustando prompts, parâmetros e consumo de recursos para garantir qualidade, velocidade e custo-benefício.


Requisitos e Perfil:


  • Graduação concluída há pelo menos 2 anos em Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia de TI, Engenharia de Computação ou Ciência de Dados;
  • Conhecimento em SQL, Python e fundamentos de machine learning;
  • Experiência comprovada em Power BI ou Looker Studio (modelagem, DAX/LookML, publicação);
  • Inglês técnico;
  • Interesse por cybersecurity.


Diferenciais:


  • Projetos de IA em produção - documentação do problema, stack utilizada e impacto gerado;
  • Projetos com LLMs, LangChain, RAG ou chatbots;
  • Certificações PL-300 (Power BI Data Analyst), DP-100 (Azure Machine Learning Engineer) ou Google Cloud Professional Machine Learning Engineer;
  • Vivência com dados de segurança da informação ou SaaS B2B.
  • Experiência com MLOps, incluindo CI/CD de modelos e monitoramento de drift.


Sobre a UPX:


Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

Contamos com unidades em Campinas (SP) e Miami (EUA), além de uma estrutura robusta com times técnicos de elite em Segurança da Informação, Engenharia de Redes, SOC, NOC e Scrubbing Centers.

Na UPX, trabalhamos todos os dias para tornar a internet mais segura, confiável e eficiente para empresas e pessoas.

title: SDR Outbound
description:
Sobre a Mobiis


A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e promover a inovação na cadeia logística, resultado da união de duas empresas do setor: Fretefy e Pathfind. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais avançadas para oferecer as melhores ferramentas do segmento, trazendo mais eficiência para os processos de nossos clientes e parceiros.


Resumo da função:

Responsável por prospectar ativamente leads qualificados via ligações, identificar oportunidades para os produtos SaaS da Mobiis (TMS, Marketplace de Fretes, APIs, etc.), agendar reuniões ou demonstrações para o time de vendas, e manter o funil de pré-venda saudável.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar ligações ativas para empresas potenciais, especialmente embarcadores, transportadoras, operadores logísticos.
  • Qualificar prospects (identificar dores, orçamento, decisão, timing).
  • Apresentar brevemente soluções da Mobiis, despertando interesse para demos.
  • Agendar reuniões / demos com o time de vendas (closers ou gestores de conta).
  • Registrar todas as interações no CRM (contatos, envio de materiais, follow-up).
  • Manter follow-up constante com prospects ao longo do ciclo inicial.
  • Colaborar com marketing para refinar scripts, mensagens de abordagem e campanhas de outbound.
  • Atingir metas mensais de reuniões agendadas / leads qualificados.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência prévia em função de SDR, Inside Sales ou telemarketing ativo, preferencialmente em vendas B2B ou SaaS.
  • Boa comunicação oral, clareza, persuasão e resiliência ao “não”.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e disciplinado para seguir processos.
  • Conhecimento ou familiaridade com soluções tecnológicas / SaaS é um diferencial.
  • Habilidade com CRM (uso diário, cadastros, relatórios).
  • Desejável conhecimento prévio em logística, transporte ou cadeia de suprimentos.


Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Experiência com outbound em empresas de tecnologia ou logística.
  • Inglês intermediário (para eventual contato ou materiais).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas agressivas e adaptabilidade.

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura (AWS)
description:
Sobre nós - Grupo Revise


O Grupo Revise, atua há mais de 28 anos no setor automotivo brasileiro, destaca-se pela qualidade certificada e pelo pioneirismo. Como uma empresa 100% brasileira, possui 3 marcas, sendo: (Brazzo, Mobato e Varimax), com 6 centros de distribuição estratégicos em todo o país e um amplo portfólio que inclui milhares de itens de alta qualidade em prol da satisfação dos clientes, reforçados pela certificação ISO 9001:2015.


SOBRE A MOBATO


A Mobato é uma marca que oferece soluções digitais para conectar clientes ao setor automotivo, com adaptabilidade a diversas plataformas tecnológicas e integração a sistemas ERP's e DMS's. Suas soluções digitais visam transformar o atendimento de serviços em uma experiência rápida e eficiente, eliminando burocracias e proporcionando agilidade. Priorizando a satisfação do cliente, a Mobato busca compreender suas necessidades para garantir a prosperidade dos negócios. Vem ser MOBATO!


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Administrar servidores Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, CentOS) e Windows Server em ambientes on-premise e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, segurança e desempenho.
  • Gerenciar ambientes de virtualização (KVM, Hyper-V, VMware ou Proxmox), realizando a configuração, manutenção e expansão de recursos conforme a demanda.
  • Implementar e manter containers Docker, apoiando as equipes de desenvolvimento na criação e sustentação de ambientes de aplicação.
  • Atuar na administração de ambientes cloud em AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud Platform, incluindo rotinas de backup, atualização de sistemas, controle de acesso e monitoramento de performance.
  • Configurar e utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento como CloudWatch, Datadog, Prometheus e Grafana, assegurando a visibilidade e estabilidade da infraestrutura.
  • Realizar suporte técnico e atendimento a chamados de infraestrutura e tecnologia para todas as empresas do grupo, identificando e solucionando incidentes de forma ágil.
  • Executar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em hardware, ativos de rede e sistemas de comunicação, garantindo o funcionamento contínuo dos serviços.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de suporte remoto (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, entre outras) para atendimento e resolução de demandas técnicas.
  • Operar ferramentas de colaboração e gestão de chamados, como Fortinet, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams e GLPI, contribuindo para a comunicação e rastreabilidade das ações.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de segurança da informação, aplicando boas práticas de proteção de dados, controle de acessos e resposta a incidentes básicos.
  • Elaborar e manter documentação técnica e procedimentos operacionais, garantindo a padronização e o compartilhamento do conhecimento dentro do time.



O que esperamos de você:


  • Conhecimento avançado em hardware, Linux e Docker.
  • Experiência na administração de servidores Microsoft e Linux, preferencialmente em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).
  • Vivência em suporte técnico de 1º e 2º nível a usuários e diferentes áreas da empresa.


Você se destaca se tiver:


  • Certificação AWS



#LI-Hybrid

title: Jr Flavorist – Savoury Applications
description:
Responsibilities

  • Develop and formulate stable, high-performing flavour solutions tailored to savoury food and beverage applications.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Kerry, including EUMs (End-Use Markets), to align flavour development with customer needs.
  • Participate in technical presentations and product demonstrations for clients, showcasing flavour performance and innovation.
  • Conduct daily organoleptic evaluations of raw materials as part of ongoing flavourist training and sensory development.
  • Maintain a working knowledge of global flavour regulations, labeling requirements, and compliance standards.
  • Support senior flavourists in internal and external flavour development projects, contributing to concept creation and execution.
  • Engage in sensory panels and other developmental activities to refine flavour perception and profiling skills.
  • Continuously study flavour chemistry, raw material interactions, and formulation techniques to enhance expertise.


Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Life Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent industry experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years hands-on experience in flavour development, preferably in savoury applications.
  • Proven track record of successful commercial flavour creation and project management.
  • Prior experience working with savoury flavour profiles is essential.
  • Ability to independently lead flavour projects from concept to commercialization.
  • Skilled in leveraging Kerry’s proprietary technologies to deliver differentiated flavour solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting abilities and adaptability in dynamic environments.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; able to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Intermediate to advanced proficiency in English communication, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, flexibility, and a proactive approach to continuous learning.


About Kerry

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Analista de Operações Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Realizar o controle do faturamento do condomínio;
  • Realizar o rateio de despesas operacionais entre lojistas, garantindo a correta alocação dos custos por centro de custo;
  • Acompanhar manutenções preventivas e corretivas das áreas comuns do shopping, controlando cronogramas e performance de prestadores;
  • Controlar e lançar contratos, garantindo cumprimento de prazos e documentação exigida;
  • Acompanhar indicadores operacionais e metas relacionadas à eficiência, consumo e manutenções;
  • Alimentar e manter atualizadas as documentações técnicas e legais do empreendimento e nos sistemas de gestão operacional;
  • Monitorar e analisar os consumos comuns e específicos (água, energia, gás), propondo ações de correção e economia;
  • Elaborar apresentações mensais com os resultados e indicadores da área de Operações, apoiando reuniões gerenciais e tomadas de decisão.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência com CAPEX, obras ou operações de shopping;
  • Excel avançado; desejável conhecimento em SAP.


Informações adicionais:

O Que Temos Para Você

title: Technical Sales Manager (Master Brewer)
description:
About the role

The Brewing Specialist will lead technical and customer-driven initiatives to support innovation and renovation of Kerry’s offerings in the alcoholic beverage sector, with a strong focus on beer brewing. This role is responsible for building strategic client relationships, driving adoption of Kerry technologies, and aligning with cross-functional teams to deliver excellence across LATAM.


Key responsibilities

  • Lead with technical insights and leverage customer/consumer feedback to drive innovation and renovation of Kerry’s offerings.
  • Align with the RDA (Research, Development & Applications) team to ensure cross-functional excellence and consistent ways of working.
  • Own and manage the overall relationship with assigned clients, including onboarding, implementation, and increasing adoption of Kerry technologies.
  • Establish a high level of customer intimacy and build trusted, strategic relationships to drive continued value.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.


Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!


Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.


We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.


Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).



Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.


Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Engenheiro de Software Embarcado
description:
Must Have Technical/Functional Skills

· hands-on experience in Automotive ECU development and embedded software

engineering, covering complete V-model lifecycle.

· Deep technical expertise in CAN, UDS, Diagnostics, and automotive communication protocols

with proven track record in software integration and testing.

· Expertise in Embedded C/C++, CAPL, RTOS, Device Drivers, MCAL

· Understanding of Continuous Integration/Continuous (CI/CD) using Jenkins, and version control

systems like Git and SVN.

· Strong understanding of ASPICE, ISO 26262 (Functional Safety), and Agile/Scrum development

methodologies.

· Understanding of AUTOSAR methodology

· Excellent analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities with a holistic understanding of

hardware-software co-development.

· Experienced in conducting design/code reviews, and driving technical excellence across cross-

functional teams.


Roles & Responsibilities

1. Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units). · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments). · Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar. 2. System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints. 3. Functional Safety & Quality Compliance · Ensure software development complies with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) standards. · Support internal and external audits (ASPICE, Functional Safety, or OEM quality audits). 4. Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure. 5. Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries. 6. Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?


“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."


Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer


What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.


Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:

  • Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
  • Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
  • Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
  • Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events and knowledge sessions.


This will make you better:

  • contract for indefinite period of time;
  • an all-in employee benefit package ( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
  • good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.


This will keep you healthy:

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.


What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
  • You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
  • A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
  • Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
  • You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
  • You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

  • Organização e precisão: registrar dados e cumprir processos com excelência.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for "Embedded Software Engineer " who wants to learn and transform his career


Responsibility :


-Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units) . · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments ).

- Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar.

-System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints.

-Functional Safety & Quality Compliance · Ensure software development complies with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) standards. · Support internal and external audits (ASPICE, Functional Safety, or OEM quality audits).

-Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure.

- Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries.

- Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Com mais de 22 anos de atuação, a UPX é referência em cibersegurança e performance digital, protegendo ambientes críticos com atuação 24x7.

Especialistas em mitigação de ataques DDoS, prevenção de incidentes e entrega de conteúdo com alta performance, atendemos grandes players dos setores financeiro, bancário, operadoras e ISPs — no Brasil e nos EUA.

description:

The Brewing Specialist will lead technical and customer-driven initiatives to support innovation and renovation of Kerry’s offerings in the alcoholic beverage sector, with a strong focus on beer brewing. This role is responsible for building strategic client relationships, driving adoption of Kerry technologies, and aligning with cross-functional teams to deliver excellence across LATAM.

  • Lead with technical insights and leverage customer/consumer feedback to drive innovation and renovation of Kerry’s offerings.
  • Align with the RDA (Research, Development & Applications) team to ensure cross-functional excellence and consistent ways of working.
  • Own and manage the overall relationship with assigned clients, including onboarding, implementation, and increasing adoption of Kerry technologies.

  • Develop and maintain customer success strategies and share best practices across commercial teams.

  • Degree in Brewing Science, Fermentation Science, Food Science, or a related field (preferred).
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a commercial brewing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of brewing equipment, ingredients, and techniques.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance and laboratory testing procedures.
  • Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese is required.
  • Strong communication, strategic planning, and project management skills.
  • Analytical and process-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working across multiple departments in a deadline-driven environment.
  • Active team player, self-starter, and multitasker with the ability to quickly adjust priorities.
  • Passion for craft beer and innovation.
  • Skilled at developing and delivering compelling stories to clients and stakeholders.
  • Certification from recognized brewing institutions (e.g., Cicerone, IBD) (Desirable)
  • Experience with sustainable brewing practices (Desirable)
  • Knowledge of local and international beer styles (Desirable)

Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Production Supervisor/Coordinator - Dry-Mix Mortar & Water-based Coatings Factory
description:
Core Responsibilities:

1. Production Operations & Management

  • Oversee daily production management for both dry-mix mortar and water-based coatings lines. Schedule production tasks according to plan, ensuring production targets are met on time, in quantity, and to quality standards.
  • Supervise the entire production process from material preparation, feeding, and mixing to packaging and palletizing, ensuring smooth and efficient operations at all stages.
  • Strictly execute the production schedule, optimize production cycle times, and improve equipment utilization and Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE).

2. Team Management & Development

  • Manage daily shift operations, including personnel scheduling, task assignment, work guidance, and on-site discipline supervision.
  • Organize and implement job skill training to enhance team members' operational skills, quality awareness, and safety mindset.
  • Conduct performance evaluations for shift personnel, providing continuous feedback and coaching to build a high-performance team.

3. Quality Management & Control

  • Strictly enforce standard operating procedures and work instructions to ensure process standardization and stability.
  • Monitor in-line product quality, perform regular checks at key quality control points, and prevent the occurrence of batch quality issues.
  • Collaborate with the Quality department to analyze, address, and track quality deviations in production, and implement corrective and preventive actions.

4. Safety Production & 5S Management

  • Act as the primary safety responsible person for the shift, implementing company safety rules and regulations, organizing safety training, and conducting hazard identification.
  • Ensure all employees strictly adhere to safe operating procedures, particularly those related to dust explosion prevention and chemical handling, to eliminate safety accidents.
  • Promote and maintain 5S management in the production area, creating a clean, orderly, and safe working environment.

5. Cost Control & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor and analyze the consumption of raw materials, energy, and auxiliary supplies, striving to reduce production costs.
  • Assist in analyzing equipment failure causes to reduce unplanned downtime.
  • Proactively identify waste in the production process, actively participate in and lead continuous improvement activities (e.g., Kaizen), and propose合理化建议 (rationalization suggestions).

Mandatory Requirements:

  • College diploma or above in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Inorganic Non-metallic Materials, or related fields.
  • Minimum 5 years of production experience in the building materials industry, including at least 2 years in a Production Team Leader or Supervisor role. Must have production management experience in a dry-mix mortar or water-based coatings factory.
  • Familiar with the production processes, equipment principles, and operational procedures for dry-mix mortar/coatings (e.g., mixers, automatic packing machines, powder conveying systems, liquid mixing & dispersing equipment).
  • Strong team leadership, communication, coordination, and on-site problem-solving skills.
  • Strong quality awareness, cost consciousness, and safety mindset.
  • Ability to adapt to a factory work environment and handle work pressure.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior work experience with Sika or Saint-Gobain is highly preferred.

title: Analista de Operações Pleno
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

title: Senior Backend Engineering Analyst
description:
Sinch is a global customer engagement platform that provides communication services for businesses across messaging, voice, and email. Sinch's services are used by more than 150,000 businesses, including many of the world's largest tech companies.

Join our development team as a Senior Backend Engineering Analyst ! You will be a key player in developing modern web applications and creating surprising new products for our clients. Our team focuses on building global-scale products and managing numerous direct integrations, including Meta (Facebook) for messaging. We also integrate with various platforms using APIs, queuing, and streaming technologies.

Activities

While responsibilities vary, in a general context, here's what we expect from you daily:

  • Deliver technology projects/products aligned with the company's strategic objectives (OKRs) , collaborating with the product team to suggest and develop new functionalities.
  • Architect and develop APIs for incredible conversational experiences and integrations using modern development technologies.
  • Develop and maintain scalable backend systems for a robust, global messaging platform (e.g., WhatsApp and SMS channels).
  • Collaboratively develop and enhance distributed backend services that meet our customers' needs.
  • Actively participate in discussions about product features and technical solutions to solve customer problems and scale our solution.
  • Master integrations and communications using REST APIs .
  • Practice code versioning (Git) , with experience in Pull Requests and Code Review.
  • Work effectively in a team environment-we don't build software alone!

Requirements

  • Solid experience in a functional language, preferably Elixir.
  • Experience developing RESTful and gRPC APIs .
  • Strong knowledge of distributed system architecture, data structures, algorithms, and software design patterns .
  • Practical knowledge of Agile development methodologies .
  • Solid understanding of relational databases .
  • Experience with Unit Testing and Integration Testing .
  • English is a must. You will communicate with teams around the world daily. We expect you to have good English reading skills from the start and be willing to dedicate yourself to learning the language.

We are looking for people who:

  • Enjoy working with talented teammates to raise the technical bar for the team, seeking new solutions and bringing improvements to existing processes.
  • Adapt quickly to change.
  • Have excellent communication skills for interpersonal relationships across different teams and hierarchical levels.

In short, we seek someone willing to deep-dive into the processes, culture, people, and business of Sinch Latam, always prioritizing continuous improvement and contributing to the evolution of our products and services.

Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of other functional languages like Erlang, Go, Rust, or Clojure .
  • Knowledge of other languages like Java and Kotlin .
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices .
  • Familiarity with container technology (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes ).
  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Phoenix PubSub ).
  • Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elastic Search, etc.).

Benefits

  • Stay healthy: We cover 100% of medical and dental plans for Sinchers and eligible dependents through Bradesco Saúde.
  • Flexible benefits: With the Caju flexible benefit card, our Sinchers can choose to use benefits on food, education, and home office assistance.
  • Family first: Our Sinchers can enjoy paid maternity leave for 180 days and paternity leave for 30 days. Plus, we provide daycare assistance for kids up to five years old.
  • Everyday wellbeing: We partner with Wellhub to help Sinchers access gyms and wellness options.
  • Secure your future : Our Partnership with Prudential life insurance provides coverage for all Sinchers in the events of unexpected absences, serious illness, accidents, and disabilities.
  • Diversity and inclusion: We offer annual reimbursements for certain expenses related to disabilities and/or transgender needs.
  • Take a break: Our Sinchers can take a day off on their birthday to celebrate with their loved ones.

Our Hiring Process

In Sinch, we are committed to following a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and non-discriminatory. Our Talent Acquisition team, together with hiring managers and the rest of the interviewing team, persistently work towards identifying the candidates that best fit each open job, based on Sinch' s hiring needs and candidates' career expectations. We encourage applications from strong candidates with relevant professional backgrounds for this role. Not all applicants will meet all job requirements exactly! Even if you do not meet all job requirements, don't let that stop you from considering Sinch for the next step in your career. We are always open to candidates that could bring new ideas and perspectives to Sinch!

title: Senior Software Test Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a driven and ambitious Senior Software Test Designer with a track record to oversee the entire testing strategies, process, from planning to execution that we are looking for?

“TOPIC is unique because it combines cutting-edge technology with a strong culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. It offers the opportunity to work on impactful, real-world projects in an environment that supports both personal and professional growth."

Bohdan Dovbysh I Test Automation Engineer

What will you do as a Senior Software Test Designer?

As a Senior Software Test Designer, you’ll lead the development of automated tests and qualification tools. You’ll design and implement smart testing strategies, optimize processes, and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement. By mentoring junior engineers and acting as a sparring partner for customers, you’ll help raise the bar for quality and innovation.

Your responsibilities as a Senior Software Test Designer:

  • Overseeing the entire testing architecture/ strategies, process, from planning to execution. This role involves developing automated test capabilities, selecting tools, and defining processes for efficient and effective testing;
  • Write software (C++, C, Python) for objective, reproducible and maintainable automated tests and development of tools for qualification and integration;
  • Explore different solution approaches to achieve the best result;
  • Design, implement and optimize chosen solutions;
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders in an international, multidisciplinary, and Agile environment;
  • Review code and mentor (junior) engineers;
  • Share your expertise to elevate the team, quality, and processes;
  • Advisor and sparring partner for customers and stakeholders and inspiring others to strive for quality.

What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • challenging and interesting projects in different domains;
  • benefit from the expertise of your technical buddy and more than 100 smart colleagues;
  • focus on guiding and coaching on personal development to achieve your ambitions;
  • annual study budget and customized training program within our TOPIC Academy;
  • tech events and knowledge sessions.

This will make you better:

  • contract for indefinite period of time;
  • an all-in employee benefit package ( €61.000 – €85.000 annually): incl. competitive gross salary, net cost allowance, mobility package, 13th month payment, holiday allowance;
  • good secondary employment conditions: i.a. 26 vacation days (opportunity to buy extra days), pension scheme and relocation budget.

This will keep you healthy:

  • a good work-life balance, flexible working hours and hybrid way of working;
  • an inspiring office environment with daily fresh fruit and a gym;
  • the home office support package will turn your “home office” into an inspiring environment;
  • lots of fun during events like celebrations, sport activities and the weekly Friday afternoon drinks.

What do you bring as a Senior Software Test Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Embedded Systems or similar;
  • At least 7 years of experience in software development with Python and C/C++ in the high-tech domain;
  • You are capable of defining and overseeing the complete test architecture and strategy, ensuring consistency and quality from planning to execution;
  • A background in software development/ automation and experience with Object-Oriented programming and develop test frameworks for complex embedded systems;
  • Preferably experience with end-to-end test automation, continuous integration and setting up and maintaining ROBOT test framework;
  • You have proven experience with various testing techniques, solid knowledge of higher-level testing (system integration, component testing), and are familiar with methods such as BDD, keyword-driven testing, data-driven testing, model-based testing, and property-based testing;
  • You are a team player, solution-oriented, and proactive;
  • Motivation to continuously improve yourself and develop new skills;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.

Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.

Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

- Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units) . · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments ).

- Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar.

-System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints.

-Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure.

- Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries.

- Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

Embedded Software Design & Development · Lead the design, development, and validation of embedded software for automotive ECUs (Electronic Control Units). · Develop low-level drivers, middleware, and application layers in C/C++ (and/or AUTOSAR environments). · Ensure compliance with automotive software development standards such as MISRA C, and ASPICE. · Integrate software modules and perform debugging on target hardware using tools such as CANoe, Trace32, ETAS INCA, or similar. 2. System & Architecture Definition · Collaborate with system architects to define software architecture aligned with hardware capabilities and vehicle-level requirements. · Participate in requirement analysis and derive detailed software specifications from system-level inputs. · Optimize system performance, memory, and power consumption within embedded constraints. 3. Functional Safety & Quality Compliance · Ensure software development complies with ISO 26262 (Functional Safety) standards. · Support internal and external audits (ASPICE, Functional Safety, or OEM quality audits). 4. Testing, Validation & Verification · Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation. · Automate test procedures where applicable using tools like Python, CAPL, or Vector tools. · Analyze test results, perform root cause analysis, and drive issue resolution to closure. 5. Cross-functional Collaboration · Work closely with hardware and systems, teams for end-to-end ECU development and validation. · Interface with Tier-1 suppliers to clarify requirements, deliverables, and technical queries. 6. Documentation & Configuration Management · Maintain detailed technical documentation: requirements traceability, design specifications, and release notes. · Use version control and configuration management tools (Git, Jira, etc.) effectively. · Ensure all software artifacts meet traceability, review, and release standards.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

title: Engenheiro mecânico
description:
Mechanical Engineering

Looking for:

We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Mechanical Engineer to join our team. This position

will provide you with the opportunity to work on exciting development projects, helping to create and

bring innovative products to life. You will apply your experience in mechanical design, CAD modeling,

prototyping, while working alongside cross-functional teams to ensure the product meets all

requirements from concept to production.

The Mechanical Engineer Reporting to the Staff (USA), Engineer out of Campinas.

The Candidate:

You have experience engineering new products and/or handling touchpoints throughout the

concept to manufacturing journey. You’ve either built or supported bringing new products to the

world, handling mechanical engineering design, research, testing, prototyping, and validation.

You have experience working with mass manufactured product and are familiar with a variety of

materials. You’re willing to research, learn, adapt and take initiative but not afraid of taking on

challenges.

The Qualifications :

  • 3+ years of experience in product development and mechanical engineering. Must have a portfolio with previously launched and manufactured products.
  • Proven experience within consumer electronics /household appliance industry and related industries focused on mechanical engineering
  • Engineering degree preferably Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Highly proficient and deeply familiar with CAD tools (Solidworks, Onshape, or Creo) and prior experience with a variety of prototyping approaches
  • Hands-on experience with prototyping, 3D printing, or other fabrication tools is a plus.
  • Experience with a wide range of materials (plastics, metals, rubbers) and knowledge informing the material selection process.
  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach challenges methodically applying analytical skills with proactive issue resolution- creating and guiding root cause analysis and DOE’s.
  • Passion for product development: Interest in consumer product design, manufacturing, and mechanical systems.
  • Strong communication skills: Ability to work well with cross-functional teams and convey technical concepts clearly. Strong Presentation skills - especially conveying technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Excellent project management skills- with experience tracking numerous development projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to travel to Asia including Hong Kong, China, Vietnam, South Korea, and Taiwan.
  • Ability to work in English

The Job:

As Mechanical Engineer, you will:

  • Help to lead (and lead) development work from product definition through manufacturing.
  • Communicate progress to team members and project requirements for development and manufacturing.
  • Work closely with NYC and Asia teams to communicate and determine direction & solve development problems as they arise.
  • Collaborate with NY/Asia engineering teams to ensure the engineering designs meet client requirements and design intent.

The Responsibilities:

  • Assist and lead Mechanical Design: Support the design and development of product by creating 3D CAD models, producing engineering drawings, and necessary documentation. i.e. lead mechanical design engineering of a product from inception to manufacturing.
  • Prototyping & Testing: Build and test prototypes to validate designs, including hands-on assembly and working with external suppliers for prototype development.
  • Ensure efficient product development cycle with detailed prototyping, testing, and validation throughout the process.
  • Ensuring designs align with performance, material, and cost targets determined for each project.
  • Collaborate with Teams: Work closely with the engineering and design teams to ensure that products meet functional, material, and aesthetic goals. Communicate with marketing, operations, and manufacturing teams to align on project updates and requirements.
  • Support and Create Documentation: Assist with maintaining and updating CAD models and related product documentation (3D, 2D, etc.).
  • Product Testing: Help conduct off-tool and in-market sample testing, participate in troubleshooting and debugging design issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Learn from Experienced Engineers: Continue to build experience in various materials and different stages of product development while learning best practices from senior and staff engineers.
  • Support Supply Chain Efforts: Collaborate with the sourcing and supply chain teams to help gather information and support procurement of materials and components.
  • Providing technical feedback and assets to support sourcing & supply chain teams, working closely with manufacturing engineers and suppliers.
  • Handle multiple projects and work independently.
  • Provide Engineering Support and Analysis to NY and HK engineering teams.
  • Build inhouse prototypes or scope external partners to prototype designs.

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura (AWS)
description:
Sobre nós - Grupo Revise

O Grupo Revise, atua há mais de 28 anos no setor automotivo brasileiro, destaca-se pela qualidade certificada e pelo pioneirismo. Como uma empresa 100% brasileira, possui 3 marcas, sendo: (Brazzo, Mobato e Varimax), com 6 centros de distribuição estratégicos em todo o país e um amplo portfólio que inclui milhares de itens de alta qualidade em prol da satisfação dos clientes, reforçados pela certificação ISO 9001:2015.

SOBRE A MOBATO

A Mobato é uma marca que oferece soluções digitais para conectar clientes ao setor automotivo, com adaptabilidade a diversas plataformas tecnológicas e integração a sistemas ERP's e DMS's. Suas soluções digitais visam transformar o atendimento de serviços em uma experiência rápida e eficiente, eliminando burocracias e proporcionando agilidade. Priorizando a satisfação do cliente, a Mobato busca compreender suas necessidades para garantir a prosperidade dos negócios. Vem ser MOBATO!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Administrar servidores Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, CentOS) e Windows Server em ambientes on-premise e cloud, garantindo disponibilidade, segurança e desempenho.
  • Gerenciar ambientes de virtualização (KVM, Hyper-V, VMware ou Proxmox), realizando a configuração, manutenção e expansão de recursos conforme a demanda.
  • Implementar e manter containers Docker, apoiando as equipes de desenvolvimento na criação e sustentação de ambientes de aplicação.
  • Atuar na administração de ambientes cloud em AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud Platform, incluindo rotinas de backup, atualização de sistemas, controle de acesso e monitoramento de performance.
  • Configurar e utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento como CloudWatch, Datadog, Prometheus e Grafana, assegurando a visibilidade e estabilidade da infraestrutura.
  • Realizar suporte técnico e atendimento a chamados de infraestrutura e tecnologia para todas as empresas do grupo, identificando e solucionando incidentes de forma ágil.
  • Executar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em hardware, ativos de rede e sistemas de comunicação, garantindo o funcionamento contínuo dos serviços.
  • Utilizar ferramentas de suporte remoto (AnyDesk, TeamViewer, entre outras) para atendimento e resolução de demandas técnicas.
  • Operar ferramentas de colaboração e gestão de chamados, como Fortinet, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams e GLPI, contribuindo para a comunicação e rastreabilidade das ações.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de segurança da informação, aplicando boas práticas de proteção de dados, controle de acessos e resposta a incidentes básicos.
  • Elaborar e manter documentação técnica e procedimentos operacionais, garantindo a padronização e o compartilhamento do conhecimento dentro do time.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Conhecimento avançado em hardware, Linux e Docker.
  • Experiência na administração de servidores Microsoft e Linux, preferencialmente em ambientes cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
About the job

We are a leading global technology company operating in the high-growth sector of On-Demand Consumer Services . Leveraging innovative technology and proven strategies from a global digital commerce leader, we are driving massive international expansion. We offer a challenging, fast-paced environment and an unparalleled opportunity to build and scale a business from the ground up in new markets.

  • Outcome Achievement and Review : Ensure work objectives are achieved successfully. Conduct reviews of work processes, explore more efficient methods, summarize experiences, and accumulate valuable insights for future work.

  • Management Experience : Proven experience in managing sales teams , with outstanding performance in a high-growth company over the past years.

Join us to witness the rapid growth of a global digital giant's international business expansion and experience firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking, expanding your international perspective, and deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation.

title: SDR Outbound
description:
Sobre a Mobiis

A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e promover a inovação na cadeia logística, resultado da união de duas empresas do setor: Fretefy e Pathfind. Utilizamos as tecnologias mais avançadas para oferecer as melhores ferramentas do segmento, trazendo mais eficiência para os processos de nossos clientes e parceiros.

Resumo da função:

Responsável por prospectar ativamente leads qualificados via ligações, identificar oportunidades para os produtos SaaS da Mobiis (TMS, Marketplace de Fretes, APIs, etc.), agendar reuniões ou demonstrações para o time de vendas, e manter o funil de pré-venda saudável.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Realizar ligações ativas para empresas potenciais, especialmente embarcadores, transportadoras, operadores logísticos.
  • Qualificar prospects (identificar dores, orçamento, decisão, timing).
  • Apresentar brevemente soluções da Mobiis, despertando interesse para demos.
  • Agendar reuniões / demos com o time de vendas (closers ou gestores de conta).
  • Registrar todas as interações no CRM (contatos, envio de materiais, follow-up).
  • Manter follow-up constante com prospects ao longo do ciclo inicial.
  • Colaborar com marketing para refinar scripts, mensagens de abordagem e campanhas de outbound.
  • Atingir metas mensais de reuniões agendadas / leads qualificados.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência prévia em função de SDR, Inside Sales ou telemarketing ativo, preferencialmente em vendas B2B ou SaaS.
  • Boa comunicação oral, clareza, persuasão e resiliência ao “não”.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e disciplinado para seguir processos.
  • Conhecimento ou familiaridade com soluções tecnológicas / SaaS é um diferencial.
  • Habilidade com CRM (uso diário, cadastros, relatórios).
  • Desejável conhecimento prévio em logística, transporte ou cadeia de suprimentos.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Experiência com outbound em empresas de tecnologia ou logística.
  • Inglês intermediário (para eventual contato ou materiais).
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com metas agressivas e adaptabilidade.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Marketing

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Você fará parte de um time que cria e evolui soluções no ecossistema Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud. O papel envolve desenvolvimento com alta qualidade e performance, integrações e desenho de dados, colaborando com equipes de projeto e interagindo com suporte global em inglês.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno
description:

• Experiência com estruturas Javascript ou JS (Jquery, Angular, Node);

• Experiência com Git, Azure, SVN, ou sistemas de controle de versões similares;

Modelo de contratação: CLT

Modelo de trabalho: 100% Remoto

Horário de trabalho: Das 10h00 ás 19h00

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).

  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).

O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

description:

We’re seeking a Sales Manager to drive growth across LATAM. You will sell nutraceutical ingredients to the dietary supplement and functional food & beverage industries, building a high-quality pipeline and long-term customer relationships.

• Proficiency with MS Office and CRM (ZOHO preferred).

title: UX/UI Designer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


You’ll be working alongside our Lead Desktop Designer day-to-day, while also collaborating regularly with the larger design team, motion graphics team, and user acquisition team to bring ideas to life from wireframes to polished UIs. While the lead drives the vision, you’ll turn concepts into reality with speed, precision, and polish. You’ll also stay responsive to shifting priorities, adapt to quick turnarounds, and always design with developer feasibility in mind. This is not a research- or strategy-heavy role. We’re looking for someone who’s happy to execute, tweak, and finesse. If you love clean pixels, smooth systems, and being the reliable engine behind great product design this is your role.


Key Responsibilities


  • Translate wireframes and rough concepts into crisp, production-ready designs
  • Build and maintain high-quality UI components for browser extensions and desktop apps
  • Collaborate closely with our lead designer and developers to ensure fast, clean handoff
  • Make smart decisions about when to polish vs. when to ship
  • Adapt to shifting priorities and irregular work cadences without missing a beat
  • Keep designs tight, lean, and respectful of developer constraints
  • Bring taste and craft, even to tight-turnaround projects
  • Contribute to a shared design system and maintain consistency across platforms


Who You Are


  • 3+ years of UI/UX experience with a strong emphasis on desktop design
  • A portfolio that shows clean, dev-friendly UI work—bonus for any
  • browser-related experience or browser extension examples
  • Deep proficiency with Figma and an efficient, systemized approach to
  • design
  • Ability to take direction, iterate fast, and not get precious
  • Strong eye for detail and consistency
  • Comfort working in ambiguity and shifting strategies
  • Respect for dev workloads—your work should make their lives easier, not
  • harder
  • Reliable, communicative, and fun to work with under pressure


Nice to Have


  • Experience designing responsive layouts for desktop applications, with
  • consideration for mobile and adaptive views
  • Light working knowledge of HTML/CSS/JS (enough to understand
  • constraints)
  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for speed and
  • inspiration
  • Familiarity with accessibility and internationalization basics
