Who We Are 


Pressure Washing Marketing Pros is a digital marketing agency focused on Google Ads, SEO, and high-converting web design for exterior cleaning companies. By focusing on this niche, we’ve discovered and scaled on repeatable processes that allow us to:


Execute based on data and beat “seat of the pants” traditional strategies.

Deliver predictable, high-quality leads with our proven Google Ads system.

Scale results by constantly testing, refining, and optimizing our paid campaigns.

Our speed, output, and constant improvement help set us apart from our competition.

Your Role & Impact 


As a Google Ads Specialist on our team, you’ll execute and optimize campaigns across 70+ Google Ads accounts and 25+ Local Service Ads accounts. You’ll join our existing Google Ads Manager and Google Ads Specialist who have been with the company for years and who are experts with our system. You and the current Specialist will follow our framework, while proactively collaborating with our SEO and client success teams to ensure campaigns are always in-line with overall business goals.


Key Responsibilities 


Build campaigns in Google Ads Manager and Ads Editor following our templates and SOPs.

Perform weekly and monthly optimization routines (negative keywords, search term reviews, budgets, ad assets, keyword additions, bidding strategy, etc. ). 

Run through QA checklist before launching or editing a campaign (geo settings, match types, naming conventions, conversion actions, etc. ). 

Maintain documentation and task updates in ClickUp. 

Implement and QA tracking with WhatConverts following established processes.

Run reports in Looker Studio with performance analysis.

Manage Local Service Ads (budget pacing, category, verification checks, etc. ). 

Proactively collaborate with SEO and client success managers to align campaign performance with business goals.

Identify areas of improvement to our SOPs based on test results or recurring events.

What You’ll Need to Succeed 


Minimum of 2 years experience managing Google Ads campaigns for lead generation (non-ecommerce).

Track record of precision execution and zero critical errors in recent work.

Great analytical skillset for search term review, budget pacing, and campaign adjustments.

Familiar with Google Ads Manager, Google Ads Editor, GA4, GTM, Looker Studio, ClickUp, and Slack.

Focus on detail, with ability to follow SOPs 100% and identify opportunities for SOP refinement.

Excellent written English for writing ads, documentation, and communicating with cross-functional teams.

Self-motivated and results-oriented, with strong personal standards for flawless execution.

Bonus Experience (not required): 


Experience with Local Service Ads management 

Unbounce 

Experience optimizing paid campaigns for service-based lead generation

Experience with WhatConverts or CallRail 

What We Value  


Data-Driven Execution – Campaigns are backed by analytics, SOPs, and real-time data.

Ownership & Accountability – We don’t micromanage. We hire A-players who take pride in precision and results.

Proactive Communication – Solutions-oriented communication that is clear and timely across departments and time zones.

Fast-Paced Execution – Weekly optimizations and QA routines are non-negotiable.

Continuous Improvement – We are always refining our systems to push performance higher.

Success Metrics 


Zero critical errors found in QA across all campaigns.

100% of weekly optimization routines completed on time.

Campaign pacing within ±5% of budget plan. 

Negative keyword coverage improves irrelevant query share quarter-over-quarter.

Reporting completeness rate 95%+ as measured by manager audit.

Compensation, Benefits, and Schedule 


Base Salary: $1,200–$2,000 USD/month depending on experience and skill level.

Schedule: Flexible work hours but must be available for mandatory 4-hour team overlap for collaboration with cross-department teams.

Multi-Step Hiring Process 


We’re serious about hiring because we’re serious about building a team of disciplined executors who thrive in a high-performance culture.


The hiring process:  


Application and screening questions. 

Paid trial project with strict QA rubric. 

Final interview and debrief with the manager and CEO.

description:

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Direct Response Video Editor for 8-Figure DTC Brand
description:
Direct Response Video Editor (Remote - Brazil Preferred)


$1,200-$1,400 USD/month + $250+ Monthly Performance Bonuses


We're an 8-figure DTC beauty & wellness brand generating $1M+ in monthly revenue through high-volume, high-converting video advertising. We need an elite video editor who understands direct response mechanics and can produce scroll-stopping ads at scale.


Your work will directly drive sales across Meta, YouTube, and emerging platforms—with immediate feedback from millions of impressions monthly.


What You'll Actually Do


High-Volume Ad Production (40-60 ads/month): Transform raw creator footage, UGC clips, and b-roll into persuasive short-form ads (15-90 seconds) and VSLs that convert cold traffic into buyers. You'll work across multiple products and funnels simultaneously.


Master Direct Response Mechanics:

  • Craft hooks that stop thumbs in the first 3 seconds (pattern interrupts, bold claims, visual glitches)
  • Deploy engagement disruptors: kinetic typography, callout graphics, progress bars, emoji reactions
  • Optimize pacing for platform algorithms (Meta 9:16, YouTube Shorts)
  • A/B test visual approaches based on performance data


Post-Production Excellence Color grading, sound design, motion graphics, and seamless transitions using Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve. Your edits should feel polished but authentic—not overproduced.


Rapid Iteration & Testing Partner with our Creative Strategist to test new concepts weekly. Expect fast feedback cycles and the need to pivot based on real-time campaign data. Speed + quality = your competitive advantage here.


AI-Enhanced Workflow Leverage tools like Descript, Runway, and AI caption generators to maximize output without sacrificing quality. We value efficiency and smart automation.


Top Fits Will Have:

  • Strong level of fluent English fluency (hard requirement)
  • 2+ years editing for DTC/eCommerce brands (beauty, health, or supplements ideal)
  • Portfolio demonstrating direct response ads that drove conversions (show us your winners)
  • Expert-level proficiency in Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve + After Effects
  • Deep understanding of Meta/YouTube Shorts specs and algorithm-friendly editing patterns
  • Native fluency with UGC aesthetics (raw, authentic, relatable) vs. polished brand content
  • Proven ability to produce 8-12 ads per week without compromising quality
  • Ability to think critically and recommend new approaches, ad formats, and tools (outside the box)


Bonus Points:

  • Experience editing short-form VSLs (2-3+ minutes) or long-form VSLs (25+ minutes)
  • Motion design skills (After Effects, Cinema 4D)
  • Understanding of direct response copywriting principles
  • Familiarity with CapCut, Descript, or AI editing tools
  • Portuguese + English fluency


Non-Negotiables:

  • Fast turnaround times (24-48 hour revisions)
  • Self-directed work ethic in a remote environment
  • Obsessive attention to detail
  • Ego-free collaboration and receptiveness to feedback



Why Top Editors Choose Us:


Transparent Compensation Base salary + monthly performance bonuses tied to ad performance metrics. Top performers earn 20-30% above base.


Career Growth Path Start as Senior Editor → Lead Editor → Creative Director as we scale. We promote from within.


See Your Impact Daily Direct access to campaign metrics. You'll know exactly which of your ads are crushing it (and which aren't).

title: Executivo de Vendas (Brasil)
description:
Sobre a greenmetrics.ai


A greenmetrics.ai desenvolve soluções tecnológicas para ajudar cidades na adaptação climática e sustentabilidade ambiental.


Desenvolvemos sistemas de sensores inteligentes e análises de dados avançadas para coletar e processar informações ambientais, contribuindo diretamente para aumentar a resiliência das cidades frente a enchentes e alagamentos.


Vislumbramos um futuro em que a tecnologia e a engenhosidade humana atuam como aliadas do mundo natural, um futuro em que os dados orientam nosso caminho rumo a um modo de vida mais sustentável, equilibrado e resiliente, preservando o delicado equilíbrio do planeta para as próximas gerações.


Somos uma startup independente e lucrativa, com tecnologia comprovada e sistemas em operação em mais de 15 cidades em Portugal e no Brasil, em rápida expansão.


Sobre a vaga


Esta é uma oportunidade para quem quer vender com propósito e ter impacto positivo no mundo real. 


Como Executivo de Vendas na greenmetrics.ai, você será a ponte entre nossas soluções tecnológicas e as necessidades urgentes das cidades brasileiras para melhorar sua capacidade de adaptação a eventos climáticos extremos. 


No dia a dia, você vai prospectar novas oportunidades, visitar clientes, gerir o pipeline de leads, preparar propostas e fechar contratos que contribuem diretamente para criar cidades mais resilientes. 


Seu trabalho vai contribuir para apoiar autoridades de emergência a priorizar áreas de risco, monitorar níveis de água em tempo real e tomar decisões informadas durante eventos extremos que se tornam cada vez mais frequentes e severos.


Suas responsabilidades


  • Prospectar e qualificar oportunidades na Região Sul do Brasil (RS/SC/PR).
  • Agendar e conduzir visitas presenciais a municípios, apresentando casos de uso para monitorização hidrológica e detecção antecipada de inundações.
  • Gerir o pipeline no CRM, garantindo dados atualizados e previsões de receita estimada.
  • Preparar provas de conceito com leads estratégicos e elaborar propostas comerciais.
  • Negociar condições comerciais e acompanhar processos de compras públicas.
  • Fechar contratos e garantir a transição para implementação e sucesso do cliente.
  • Manter relacionamento com líderes municipais e fomentar expansão de contas.
  • Representar a empresa em eventos, reforçando credibilidade técnica e institucional.
  • Coletar feedback do cliente para o time de produto/engenharia.


O que procuramos


  • +5 anos em vendas B2B ou para o setor público, preferencialmente em soluções tecnológicas ou SaaS.
  • Histórico comprovado de performance com superação de meta, condução de ciclos de venda longos, contratos de alto valor, cases documentados e referências de clientes.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, condução de reuniões executivas e apresentações técnico-comerciais.
  • Experiência com ferramentas CRM e gestão de pipeline, métricas de funil e forecast.
  • Negociação e gestão de stakeholders com postura colaborativa e foco em resultado.
  • Autonomia e disciplina operacional para planejar rotas, viajar para visitas comerciais e cumprir agendas de campo com eficiência.
  • Base na região de Porto Alegre ou Florianópolis e disponibilidade para viajar (mandatório).
  • Formação em engenharia, hidrologia ou tecnologia é desejável.


O que oferecemos


  • Salário fixo + comissões agressivas.
  • Produto comprovado, de alto impacto social e ambiental e forte proposta de valor.
  • Playbooks, ferramentas e mentoria do nosso time técnico e comercial.
  • Ambiente hands-on, autonomia e impacto concreto e mensurável.


Como se candidatar


Sabemos que você tem uma rotina intensa e respeitamos seu tempo, então basta compartilhar seu currículo atualizado com os detalhes relevantes sobre sua formação e experiência.


Inclua: sua experiência em vendas B2B ou setor público, exemplos de métodos e abordagens comerciais que você utilizou e principais resultados obtidos.

  • Lead the overall design, including the structure of a segment solution based on requirements from the business, global and regional views, as well as the design of standard software configurations.
  • Building delivery blueprints including but not limited to application diagrams, physical architecture, process diagrams, systems maps, service interfaces, technical interfaces, data modeling, integration planning.
  • Translates non-functional and functional requirement into solution designs, ensuring solution aligns with business goals and processes, uses and provides enterprise information consistently, integrates effectively with other applications, supports a common application environment and user interaction model, uses the common technology platform, and achieves enterprise level security, quality of service and scale.

  • Participates in client's Community of Practice forum with other Solution Architects.

  • Contributes to the evaluation and selection of software product standards.

  • Able to communicate technical information in a non-technical manner to Business team (written and verbal).

  • Strong leadership skills
  • Creative thinking

  • Experience collaborating with Enterprise Architects and infrastructure engineers to identify, design, and implement highly complex, end-to-end solutions.

  • Broad range of business and IT experiences

  • Ability to work in a virtual team across distance, with different cultures and time zones, in a matrix with multiple reporting lines, with on-shore and off-shore resources (may extend outside the organization including suppliers, partners and customers).

description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.

Job Title: L2 Security Engineer - EDR Solutions (CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne)

Location: Hybrid, 24x7 Shifts

Job Type: Full-Time (Rotational Shift Model, including weekends and holidays)


Job Summary:

As an L2 Security Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the smooth operation of EDR solutions by monitoring platform health, enforcing security policies, and troubleshooting endpoint issues across multiple EDR platforms including CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne. Your role includes onboarding devices, validating security rules, handling basic policy enforcement issues, and ensuring that all endpoints remain compliant with security baselines. You will assist in resolving connectivity issues, missing telemetry cases, and agent health checks while escalating complex platform-related problems to L3.


Key Responsibilities:

· Ensure endpoints are successfully onboarded to EDR solutions across all platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android).

· Monitor endpoint connectivity and health status within the EDR portals.

· Validate that security rules, EDR, and antivirus policies are applied correctly.

· Assist in troubleshooting policy conflicts and enforcement issues.

· Investigate and validate EDR alerts, classify threats, and escalate incidents if required.

· Apply basic remediation steps like isolating devices, initiating scans, or triggering automated investigations.

· Identify endpoints not reporting telemetry or experiencing EDR agent failures.

· Perform basic troubleshooting (e.g., restarting services, re-onboarding devices, checking connectivity).

· Escalate complex security incidents and persistent issues to L3.

· Assist in preparing incident summaries and compliance reports for management.

· Ensure endpoints are running the latest security patches and EDR updates.

· Validate compliance with security baselines and recommend corrective actions.

· Collaborate with global SOC, Threat Hunting, and Incident Response teams for critical security incidents.


Required Skills & Knowledge:

· Hands-on expertise in CrowdStrike, Palo Alto XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and SentinelOne.

· Ability to analyze malware behaviors, execute incident containment strategies, and escalate threats appropriately.

· Scripting knowledge in PowerShell or Python (preferred).

· Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.


Work Environment & Shift Requirements:

· 24x7 support model with rotational shifts (including nights, weekends, and holidays).

· Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure SOC environment.

· Excellent collaboration and coordination with global cybersecurity teams.


Preferred Certifications:

· CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator (CCFA)

· Palo Alto Networks Certified Cybersecurity Associate (PCCSA)

· Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)

· SentinelOne Certified Administrator


At HCLTech, we don’t just offer jobs — we offer journeys. Join a global team where your work drives innovation, your ideas matter, and your growth is supported every step of the way.


Why Choose HCLTech?

  • Be part of a purpose-led organization with a global footprint
  • Collaborate with diverse teams across borders
  • Work on cutting-edge technologies in enterprise integration
  • Enjoy career mobility, continuous learning, and a culture of inclusion

LeanIX Data Stewardship

Application Rationalization

  • Evaluate applications for business value (e.g., strategic alignment, user impact, cost efficiency).
  • Assess technical value (e.g., scalability, integration readiness, security posture, supportability).
  • Identify candidates for retirement, consolidation, or modernization.


Technology Mapping & Future Planning

  • Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to map future business requirements to existing technologies.
  • Support decision-making on whether to enhance current platforms or build new applications.


Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work closely with application owners, enterprise architects, and business analysts to gather insights and validate data.
  • Facilitate workshops and reviews to ensure alignment on application strategy and lifecycle decisions.


Reporting & Insights

  • Generate dashboards and reports from LeanIX to support executive decision-making.
  • Provide insights into portfolio health, redundancy, risk, and optimization opportunities.


The essential requirements of the job include:

  • 3+ years of experience in application portfolio management, enterprise architecture, or IT asset management.
  • Hands-on experience with LeanIX or similar APM tools.
  • Strong understanding of application lifecycle, business capability modeling, and technology stack analysis.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, BIZBOK) is required.

description:

Imagine your future. Care for your career. Simplify your journey.

Isso significa que você terá a chance de construir soluções de impacto, crescer com oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento e evoluir em uma cultura que valoriza bem-estar, inclusão e clareza.

Combinamos flexibilidade, autonomia e colaboração global — para que você possa focar no que importa, se conectar com propósito e ajudar a moldar o futuro.

Aqui, você vai encontrar espaço para crescer, oportunidades reais para liderar e uma cultura onde todas as pessoas pertencem e contribuem.

✨ Se você quer fazer parte da próxima geração de soluções financeiras, este é o lugar certo.

Já te imagina sendo Nxter?

Na Getnet, estamos buscando uma pessoa para a vaga de Senior Data Science Analyst para se juntar ao nosso time de Data Plataform.

O que você vai fazer

  • Desenvolver e implementar modelos de machine learning utilizando técnicas de classificação, regressão e clusterização;
  • Realizar testes de modelos de machine learning, incluindo, mas não se limitando a, testes A/B, testes de hipótese e validação cruzada;
  • Proficiente em feature engineering para otimizar os desempenhos dos modelos desenvolvidos;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para transformar dados em insights acionáveis;
  • Desenvolvimento de modelos de machine learning em cima da plataforma databricks;
  • Manutenção de modelos existentes (Acompanhamento e eventuais retreinamentos) ;
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias de dados para identificar padrões e tendências relevantes;
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de práticas de MLOps..

✅ O que buscamos em você

  • Machine Learning | Regressão, Classificação, Clusterização, Redes Neurais, Seleção de Features, Cross-Validation, "Curse of Dimensionality", Viés-Variânica, Explicabilidade de Modelos, etc;
  • Estatística Avançada | Análise Descritiva, probabilidade, inferência, bootstrapping, desing experimental, modelagem preditiva, otimização, testes de hipótese, regressão, modelagem e métodos;
  • Lógica de Programação | Escrever e revisar scrips e queries em banco de dados, usar parâmetros, criar variáveis;
  • Data Modeling | Landing, Cleaning, Processing, Curation, Estruturas de Fato/Dimensão, encadeamento de ETLs, Data Marts;
  • Big Data | Tecnologias, Soluções e Conceitos como Spark, Hadoop, Hive, MapReduce, Kafka;
  • Modelagem Estatística & Advanced Analytics | NLP, Séries Temporais, Random Forests, Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Clustering methods (e.g. K-means), Classification methods (Decision Trees/Random Forest), among others;
  • MLOps básico | para entender os desafios de se colocar um modelo em produção;
  • Experimentação | Testes A|B, Hipóteses, Modelos de Atribuição;
  • Grandes Volumes | Extrair e manipular grandes bases de dados, utilizando a stack de dados disponível.


FERRAMENTAS

  • SQL | Porque dado em planilha é coisa do passado;
  • Python ou R | Pra quando a coisa fica bem séria;
  • Scala, Java & Spark | Trabalhar com grande volume de dados sempre pode ser mais rápido;
  • Teste de Hipóteses | Para suportar o processo de tomada de decisão e criar informação de suporte;
  • Databricks | Uso de clusters e workspaces para BigData.

title: Gestor(a) Produção Agrícola
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Gestor(a) de Produção Agrícola para atuar no nosso time de Produção Agrícola.


Quais as responsabilidades?

Comandar a programação diária das atividades para o dia seguinte, alocando as turmas nas atividades de forma a obter o melhor desempenho de cada uma delas, controlar e qualificar a operação de corte manual e colheita mecanizada, sob a ótica da impureza vegetal e mineral;

Estruturar o acompanhamento do desenvolvimento vegetativo e, no caso de alguma ocorrência que venha afetar a cultura, o mesmo reportar à gerência para definir ações de controle e programar diariamente as atividades das locações das turmas para melhor desempenho;

Elaborar preço para o corte de cana, estimando por metro de cana cortada, fazendo a conversão de tonelada para metro, elaborando a coleta diária dos apontamentos de campo, cumprindo os prazos para o fechamento de vencimentos;

Organizar a entrega dos Informes diários de operações, esclarecendo diariamente a locação, quantidade de pessoas e previsão de rendimento operacional;

Supervisionar a aplicação do sistema da qualidade em sua área, implementando em parceria com a Áreade Qualidade, buscando a manutenção das certificações e cumprindo os requisitos, realizando auditorias internas e externas, executando a qualificação de fornecedores e garantindo a qualidade em todas as operações sob sua responsabilidade;

Gerir os recursos humanos da área garantindo que todas as políticas, técnicas e procedimentos sejam cumpridas, manter a equipe motivada por meio de um relacionamento saudável, visando a retenção da MO e gerar expectativa de crescimento na carreira, suprir todas as necessidades sejam técnicas ou operacionais através de treinamentos específicos;

Supervisionar a qualificação e dar condições para que a mão de obra desempenhe as atividades de forma satisfatória no rendimento operacional de plantio e colheita.


Quais os requisitos?

Ensino superior completo em agronomia ou áreas afins;

Sólida vivência em estimativa de produção agrícola, formação de lavoura e variedades de cana;

Experiência em gestão de pessoas e processos;

Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão da rotina, planejamento e orçamento;

Residir na região de Olímpia/SP.


Qual localidade?

Olímpia/SP.


O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.


Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.


Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. title: Senior Accountant
description:
Senior Accountant


Remote – Brazil


*Applications will only be considered with CVs submitted in English.


Company Overview


Sphise is a global outsourcing partner, helping international companies build and manage high-performing teams worldwide.

Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Senior Accountant to join their dynamic team.


Position Overview


As a Senior Accountant, you will play a critical role in ensuring financial accuracy and operational excellence across our international finance team. You will take ownership of complex reconciliations, advanced transaction coding, and key components of the month-end close, contributing directly to the integrity of our financial reporting.

Using your analytical mindset, technical expertise, and strong understanding of accounting principles, you will resolve discrepancies, support audits, guide junior staff, and help improve internal processes. Your ability to collaborate across departments, communicate clearly, and manage priorities will be essential as you handle AP/AR escalations, review expenses, and maintain high standards of compliance.

This position offers the opportunity to work in a structured, international environment with clear responsibilities, strong team collaboration, and room for continued professional growth.


Key Responsibilities

  • Transaction Reconciliation: Perform and review complex transaction reconciliations in QuickBooks Online; identify and resolve discrepancies independently.
  • Advanced Transaction Coding: Accurately classify and code complex transactions, including accruals, prepaids, and multi-department allocations in compliance with accounting standards.
  • Financial Reporting Support: Assist in preparing monthly financial statements and supporting schedules; contribute to month-end close processes.
  • Expense Management: Review and approve expense reports for accuracy and policy compliance; provide guidance to staff on expense procedures.
  • Accounts Payable/Receivable: Handle escalated AP/AR issues, manage aging reports, assist with collection efforts, and maintain vendor relationships.
  • Journal Entry Preparation: Prepare and post standard and adjusting journal entries; maintain supporting documentation.
  • Process Improvement: Recommend improvements to accounting procedures and help implement best practices for efficiency.
  • Audit Support: Prepare requested audit documentation and schedules; serve as a key contact for auditor inquiries.
  • Junior Staff Support: Provide guidance and answer questions from junior accounting team members as needed.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Strong proficiency in QuickBooks Online (QBO) and advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Solid understanding of GAAP and accounting principles.
  • Excellent attention to detail with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and prioritize multiple tasks effectively.
  • Strong communication skills for working with various departments and external contacts.


Preferred Experience

  • 4-6 years of progressive accounting experience.
  • Experience with month-end close processes and financial reporting.
  • Background in small-to-mid-sized business accounting environments.
  • Familiarity with expense management tools and multiple accounting software platforms.
  • Experience training or mentoring junior staff members.
  • Strong English Skills.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

We specialize in Alternative Asset Digitalization and Loyalty Innovation, empowering organizations to unlock new value through tokenization, stablecoin infrastructure, and real-world asset integration.


Our globally distributed team of innovators, builders, and thinkers is passionate about the future of finance. Join Pointsville and be part of shaping the future of digital finance!


Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly driven Product Manager to lead the end-to-end development of Pointsville’s digital products. title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including:
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institution limits and capital requirements;
  • Net-worth monitoring.
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.

Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.

title: Software Engineer
description:

title: Técnico em Lubrificação Sênior
description:
Técnico de Lubrificação Sr


Executar e supervisionar planos de lubrificação preventiva, preditiva e corretiva em equipamentos rotativos e estáticos; Definir, avaliar e aplicar os tipos adequados de lubrificantes (graxas, óleos, fluidos especiais), assegurando conformidade com especificações técnicas e recomendações de fabricantes; Monitorar o consumo e desempenho dos lubrificantes, realizando análises de tendência e propondo melhorias de confiabilidade; Realizar coleta de óleo para análise laboratorial (físico-química e ferrográfica), interpretando resultados e recomendando ações corretivas; Implementar e manter rotas de lubrificação em sistemas digitais (CMMS/ERP), garantindo rastreabilidade das atividades; Diagnosticar falhas relacionadas a sistemas de lubrificação e propor soluções para eliminação de recorrências; Orientar e treinar equipes de manutenção quanto às melhores práticas de lubrificação e inspeção de equipamentos; Acompanhar auditorias internas e externas de manutenção, fornecendo suporte técnico sobre processos de lubrificação; Atuar junto às áreas de engenharia de manutenção e confiabilidade no desenvolvimento de novos procedimentos e otimização de intervalos de lubrificação; Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de segurança, meio ambiente e qualidade na manipulação, armazenamento e descarte de lubrificantes.


Atividades:

Efetua os serviços de verificação de nível e reposição de lubrificantes em equipamentos;

Realiza a inspeção dos equipamentos, relativos à função lubrificação;

Efetua a troca de cargas de lubrificantes, bem como a sua purificação e filtragem;

Lubrifica os pontos de graxa e verifica o funcionamento em sistemas centralizados;

Efetua a lubrificação de correntes, guias, articulações, engrenagens, acoplamentos;

Cumpre a programação periódica de inspeção e lubrificação;

Efetua o levantamento de dados técnicos de equipamentos para elaboração do plano de lubrificação;

Efetua a substituição de elementos filtrantes;

Faz a coleta de amostras de lubrificantes para análise;

Limpeza específica de unidades hidráulicas;

Segrega lubrificantes usados, elementos filtrantes e desengraxantes para descarte;

Segue as instruções de trabalho e procedimentos inerentes à sua função, quando estas existirem;

Executa outras tarefas correlatas às descritas, a critério do superior imediato;

Análise dos laudos dos laboratórios decorrentes das análises dos lubrificantes;

Execução das práticas adequadas para coleta de amostras de lubrificantes;

Garantir a confiabilidade das Unidades Hidráulicas e de lubrificação (elementos filtrantes, nível de contaminação, pontos de coleta de amostras, etc);

Seguir, monitorar e garantir a aplicação dos procedimentos de segurança e meio ambiente da SKF e dos clientes

Garantir que os equipamentos rotativos das unidades fabris dos clientes não quebrem em emergência

Garantir os padrões da qualidade das Normas e Procedimentos ISO

Elaboração e revisão dos planos de Lubrificação Industrial


Requisitos & Competências:


Formação técnica em Mecânica, Mecatrônica, Automação Industrial ou áreas relacionadas.

Conhecimento de lubrificação industrial e seus princípios.

Familiaridade com diferentes tipos de lubrificantes, métodos de aplicação e equipamentos de lubrificação. Habilidade para usar ferramentas e equipamentos de medição, como medidores de viscosidade, analisadores de óleo, entre outros.

Capacidade de interpretar dados de análise de óleo e tomar medidas adequadas com base nos resultados.

Boa comunicação interpessoal e habilidades de trabalho em equipe.

Compromisso com a segurança no ambiente de trabalho.

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Ser a pessoa responsável por transformar dados brutos em informações acessíveis e confiáveis, conectando a área técnica às necessidades de negócio e garantindo que as soluções construídas sustentem a tomada de decisão estratégica da empresa.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Disseminar melhores práticas de uso e governança de dados;
  • Contribuir em projetos de migração e integração de dados;
  • Participar de discussões baseadas em dados, apoiando decisões estratégicas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência com tecnologias Microsoft Azure (Data Factory, Databricks, Synapse Analytics, Cosmos DB, SQL Database, Data Lake Storage)
  • Vivência em criação de desenhos de solução e modelagem de dados (relacionais e não relacionais);

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: Recruiting Operations Manager
description:
Company Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a US national healthcare recruiting firm that focuses on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.


We are hiring a Recruiting Operations Manager to work directly with the CEO. This person will take ideas, conversations, and action items and turn them into completed projects. The right candidate will be the operational backbone of the recruiting process, ensuring accuracy, follow-through, and consistent momentum.


If you are organized, resourceful, and skilled at turning plans into results, this role is for you.


About the CEO and the Role

Max McNamara is the CEO of Full Spectrum Search Group. With over 13 years of search experience and a degree in Technological Entrepreneurship and Management, Max combines hands-on recruiting expertise with a strong focus on systems, process, and performance. He has also served as a coach and workflow automation consultant for one of the largest recruiting firm networks in the world, helping build smarter infrastructure and scalable operations across multiple search organizations.


Max is a visionary who thrives on ideas, relationships, and growth. He’s looking for an Integrator who can bring structure, accountability, and follow-through. This role is both strategic and tactical. You’ll be a true operational partner and someone who keeps the recruiting engine running smoothly, ensures every opportunity moves from conversation to completion, and turns ideas into measurable results.


Recruiting Operations and Workflow Management

  • Attend client, candidate, and internal meetings and own the post-meeting follow-through by ensuring every conversation leads to completed next steps
  • Manage all recruiting activity in Crelate (CRM) including job orders, candidate pipelines, and client updates.
  • Keep data clean, organized, syndicated, and current across LinkedIn RPS, Crelate, and lead spreadsheets.
  • Ensure all searches are actively moving forward and nothing sits idle.
  • Create weekly progress summaries and present during weekly team meetings


Process Improvement & Automation

  • Strong emphasis on workflow automation and continually looking for relevant and savvy ways to make things more efficient, eliminate bottle necks, etc.
  • Proactively look for areas to improve process and workflows and suggest edits
  • Become the subject matter on industry tools and technologies that can lead to better results over time.


Team Coordination and Communication

  • Collaborate with internal team members to keep projects on track and deadlines met.
  • Draft clear, professional recap messages after client and candidate calls.
  • Coordinate and manage the CEO’s calendar for efficiency and balance.
  • Follow up with recruiters and support staff to make sure deliverables are completed and priorities stay aligned.


Research, Marketing, and Deliverables

  • Research operators, facilities, and leadership teams using internal templates and data sources.
  • Maintain and update tracking lists for sourcing, outreach, and facility-level research.
  • Format and proofread MPC write-ups, job descriptions, and client submissions using company templates and tone.
  • Support marketing activities including LinkedIn posts and client-facing materials to ensure brand consistency.


What You’ll Bring

  • Excellent written and spoken English suitable for professional U.S. business communication.
  • Understanding of American business culture and communication style.
  • Experience working with US-based companies in operations and/or account/project management support.
  • Strong technology background.
  • Experience using AI to increase efficiency and automation.
  • Strong organization and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects.
  • Proficiency with CRM’s, LinkedIn, Google Sheets, and ChatGPT or similar tools.
  • A proactive mindset with the ability to anticipate needs and take ownership.
  • A professional home office setup suitable for professional video calls with executives.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and consistent availability during U.S. business hours with Central Time schedule.


Ideal Background

  • Three to five years of experience in operations or project management roles.
  • Longevity on your resume with the ability to articulate your success in similar roles.
  • Experience supporting executives or business owners in fast-paced environments.
  • Background in healthcare or executive recruiting is preferred but not required.


Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary paid in USD and based on experience.
  • Full-time remote position.
  • Central Time Schedule.
  • Performance-based growth opportunities available.

title: Senior UX/UI Engineer
description:
We're seeking for a Senior UX/UI Engineer in Brazil - 100% remote


Type: 6-Month Contract (with strong potential for extension)

Location: Remote


About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior UX/UI Engineer to help build and improve internal web-based user interfaces for our Site Reliability Engineering teams. This role is ideal for a front-end engineer who loves to get hands-on with React and enjoys improving user workflows, not just coding layouts.

You’ll be working on existing internal React applications (built by engineers, for engineers) — streamlining them, improving usability, and helping implement new functionality.


What You’ll Do

  • Enhance and reorganize an existing internal React app to improve usability and maintainability.
  • Build and implement intuitive web-based interfaces used daily by internal engineering teams.
  • Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to identify UX pain points and deliver better workflows.
  • Bring a strong design sensibility to UI decisions, even if design is not your primary focus.


Must-Have Skills

  • React expertise — deep hands-on experience building and improving production React applications.
  • Experience delivering solutions using multiple front-end languages or frameworks (you’ve picked up a “second and third language”).
  • HTMX experience (required).
  • Lit experience is a plus (not mandatory).
  • Experience implementing and improving internal web-based applications.
  • Comfort working in the UX layer — improving workflow, usability, and user experience (not just layouts).


Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Some UX design experience — wireframing, talking to users, or journey mapping.
  • Experience with Go or Python (enough to be dangerous).
  • Familiarity with internal tools or applications (preferred over public-facing apps).


Soft Skills

  • Go-getter mentality — eager to learn, fix, and improve from day one.
  • Curious and proactive — someone who would say, “I saw the issues in your React app, fixed them, and I’m ready to move forward.”
  • Focused on delivering impact to end users — able to articulate what you built, why it mattered, and how it improved the experience.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Sobre a Vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a) Senior Data Scientist altamente qualificado(a) e versátil para integrar nossa equipe de analytics avançado. Nesta função, você será responsável por projetar, desenvolver e implementar sistemas de recomendação, modelos de previsão de séries temporais e soluções de machine learning baseadas em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão. Você trabalhará em estreita colaboração com equipes multifuncionais para transformar dados em insights acionáveis e soluções escaláveis.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e otimizar sistemas de recomendação (filtragem colaborativa, baseada em conteúdo, abordagens híbridas).
  • Construir e validar modelos de previsão de séries temporais utilizando técnicas tradicionais e de machine learning (ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, etc.).
  • Implementar algoritmos de boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) e árvores de decisão para diversas tarefas de aprendizado supervisionado.
  • Colaborar com engenheiros de dados e engenheiros de ML para implantar modelos em ambientes Azure e Databricks.
  • Realizar exploração de dados, engenharia de features e avaliação de modelos.
  • Apresentar descobertas e modelos de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre as mais recentes ferramentas e metodologias aplicadas em machine learning.

Requisitos:

  • Graduação ou Mestrado em Matemática, Estatística, Física ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada com sistemas de recomendação e modelos de séries temporais.
  • Sólido conhecimento em algoritmos de boosting e árvores de decisão.
  • Proficiência em Python e bibliotecas como scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, statsmodels.
  • Experiência com serviços em nuvem Azure e Databricks.
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e habilidade para trabalhar de forma independente.
  • Inglês fluente (oral e escrito).

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

É um papel híbrido entre UX/UI Designer e Front-end Low-Code : alguém que entende jornada, navegação, hierarquia de informação, microcopy e conversão, mas também entra no Webflow para estruturar coleções dinâmicas, componentes, interações, integrações e ajustes finos de layout, responsividade e performance.


Você será “dono(a)” do nosso ecossistema Webflow (e ferramentas associadas), garantindo que tudo esteja organizado, escalável e fácil de manter, sempre conectado com times de Marketing, Growth, Produto e Vendas.


ATIVIDADES:


  • Arquitetura e UX do site : estruturar menus, páginas, fluxos, componentes e coleções (CMS) alinhados à estratégia da LETS e dos produtos (Max SalesCloud, Bippi, FiboNash, etc.).
  • Implementação no Webflow : construir e manter páginas, layouts, coleções dinâmicas, formulários, interações, animações e variações responsivas (mobile-first).
  • Design System & consistência visual : organizar estilos globais (tipografia, cores, grids, componentes), garantindo coerência entre site, blog, LPs e materiais digitais.
  • Performance & SEO On-page : otimizar estrutura, headings, imagens, meta tags, URLs, links internos e boas práticas Core Web Vitals.
  • Integrações & low-code : configurar integrações com ferramentas como HubSpot, AirOps, n8n, WhatsApp/API, analytics, pixels e outros conectores sem depender sempre de dev.
  • Experimentação & conversão : propor e testar variações de páginas, CTAs, formulários e mensagens para melhorar conversão, engajamento e qualificação de leads.
  • Criação de estruturas de landing pages: desenvolver e criar modelos de landing pages escaláveis para eventos, material RICO, e outras formas de conteúdo.
  • Documentação & escalabilidade : registrar padrões, boas práticas e guidelines para que o ecossistema Webflow seja sustentável, organizado e fácil de evoluir.
  • Curiosidade técnica : explorar novas features, clonables, bibliotecas e soluções low-code/no-code que ajudem a levar o site “um passo além” sempre.


REQUISITOS:


Eliminatórios (OBRIGATÓRIO):

  • Experiência comprovada (3+ anos) construindo sites, LPs e projetos profissionais em Webflow .
  • Domínio de UX/UI básico a intermediário : wireframes, hierarquia de informação, boas práticas de navegação e usabilidade.
  • Conhecimento sólido de HTML e CSS (para ajustar o que o Webflow gera e criar soluções mais refinadas).
  • Noções de JavaScript suficientes para pequenas interações, embeds e integrações simples.
  • Experiência com design responsivo e otimização para mobile.
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de documentação técnica, tutoriais e comunidades (inclusive em inglês).
  • Perfil hands-on, curioso, autônomo , com vontade de testar, fuçar, perguntar (inclusive para IAs) e aprender rápido.


HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:


  • Experiência com Figma ou ferramenta similar para prototipação.
  • Familiaridade com integrações Webflow ↔ HubSpot , formulários, CRM, automações (n8n/Make/Zapier).
  • Conhecimento em SEO técnico , Analytics, Tag Manager e pixels.
  • Vivência com marcas B2B SaaS, logística, e-commerce ou last-mile.
  • Noções de motion design (Lottie, microinterações, GSAP ou similar).
  • Noções de A/B testing , CRO e métricas de funil.
  • Espanhol ou inglês intermediário.


BENEFÍCIOS:


  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados .
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).


DETALHES:


  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .

Envie portfólio com projetos em Webflow (links públicos ou clonables), mostrando:

Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.

What We’re Looking For

Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE


We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.


In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.


Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.


Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:

Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care

Automated coding and billing optimization

Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials

Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements


Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.


WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU


This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.


You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!


1. Build and Refine AI Products

Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers

Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy

Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions


2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy

Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough

Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products

Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy


3. Own the Development Lifecycle

Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production

Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards


4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement

Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process

Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space

In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base


REQUIRED EXPERTISE


1. Technical Skills

Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go

Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)

Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)

Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency

Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications

Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)


2. Mindset & Approach

Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment

Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly

A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team

Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing


3. Highly Valued Qualifications

Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar

Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change

Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures

Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)

Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management


Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.


WHAT WE OFFER


1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity

Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential

Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions

Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale


2. Professional Excellence

Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans

Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems

Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure

Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside


3. Work-Life Integration

Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones

Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily

Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients

Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability


READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?


If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.


Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

description:

Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


We are seeking a Full-Stack Data Engineer to join our Mobile Applications department. This is a hybrid role that combines data engineering with data science overlap, giving you full ownership of the data lifecycle — from ingestion to transformation, analysis, and storytelling.

You will build and optimize scalable pipelines, ingest mobile app data from diverse sources, ensure infrastructure reliability, and deliver insights that directly influence how our apps grow. The ideal candidate thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics, equally capable of writing production-grade pipelines and uncovering meaningful trends in user behavior.


Key Responsibilities


Data Infrastructure & Pipelines

  • Build and maintain scalable, end-to-end pipelines across cloud environments. Ingest and transform data from files, APIs, mobile telemetry (Firebase, Amplitude, Google Analytics), and external databases into centralized stores.
  • Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Implement data quality monitoring, governance policies, and best practices for privacy, security, and compliance.
  • Participate in technical architecture discussions, contributing expertise on scalable, efficient data systems.


Analytics & Insights

  • Conduct exploratory and advanced analysis using SQL, Python, and statistical methods.
  • Collaborate with Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product Managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Support experimentation and A/B testing by ensuring clean, reliable datasets and analyzing results.
  • Deliver actionable recommendations that influence mobile product strategy, user acquisition, and retention.


Collaboration & Best Practices

  • Engage in peer code reviews to uphold high standards of quality and maintainability.
  • Work cross-functionally with software engineering and business teams to ensure data solutions align with company priorities.
  • Document pipelines, workflows, and methodologies to foster reusability and knowledge sharing.


Who You Are


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar technical role focused on data infrastructure and pipelines.
  • Strong expertise in SQL and proficiency in Python (or a similar programming language such as Java or C#).

  • Strong knowledge of data warehousing concepts, ELT/ETL best practices, and dimensional modeling. Experience with version control systems (e.g., GitHub).

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
Working At Bitso

We are a diverse team that takes pride in understanding the perspectives of others. We fully embrace working remotely and we are eager to act, improve and accelerate progress inside and outside of our organization.

To drive revolutionary changes in society and make crypto useful, we delight our customers with world-class products, deep care, and intentional empathy.


Your Purpose

As a Sales Top Executive, you will be at the forefront of our growth strategy, tasked with winning commercial deals in key markets/verticals. Your role is not just about selling; it's about understanding customer pain points, leveraging our unique selling propositions (USP), and developing targeted commercial offers. Success in this role involves collaboration, strategic thinking, and meticulous pipeline management.


Reports To

Head of Sales


Who You Are

  • 10 years of experience in a sales position.
  • +4 years of experience selling remittances, cross-border payment and/or complex payments solutions.
  • Developed and executed comprehensive sales strategies for institutional and corporate clients.
  • Previous sales experience at a financial institution/large brokerage firm.
  • English fluency
  • Proven experience in business development and sales as a hunter.
  • Strong understanding of commercial strategy and pre-sales support
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Experience with CRM tools, preferably Hubspot.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams for seamless customer onboarding.


What You Will Do

  • Engage with potential customers, understand their pain points, and effectively communicate our USP (Unique Selling Proposition) to win new business.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to identify potential customers and provide structured feedback on generated leads.
  • Identify customer pain points and formulate targeted commercial offers to address their specific needs.
  • 360 sales cycle, open and close new business.
  • Document, track, and analyze the sales pipeline using the CRM tool (Hubspot) to ensure a robust and well-managed sales process.
  • Maintain, refresh, and expand the sales funnel, working closely with Sales Ops to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide regular updates to Senior Management.
  • Collaborate with various functions (e.g., KYC, Legal, Product) to facilitate a smooth customer onboarding process, ensuring a successful transition to production.
  • Work closely with the Account Manager during onboarding to ensure revenue targets are achieved, and customers have an exceptional experience.

Research in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion suggests that individuals may hesitate to apply for jobs if they do not meet all the listed criteria. At Bitso, we value diversity and your unique strengths could be just what we're looking for. If this role excites you but you don't match every point in the description, we still want to hear from you.


Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven: We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products.

So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:
