title: NetSuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – Brazil

Salary: USD 1,700/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.


MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.


Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite .
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.g., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.



Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits/credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required; IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.


About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: SAP Data Migration Lead Consultant
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.



The ROLE

We are recruiting talented and motivated individuals to join our team delivering data projects for clients across the globe. As a lead data migration consultant at Syniti, you will be responsible for managing a team of migration consultants on all aspects of data work for a process area/workstream. You will work closely with functional consultants and key customer resources, gathering requirements through workshops, building conversion objects, and driving your team’s value through all data project phases. You will be responsible for making sure that your team uses your data skills and the Syniti data management platform to assess and iterate through design, build, and deployment, ensuring that the highest customer value is derived from your assigned objects. As a lead member of a Syniti Data Migration team, you will execute against the best practices for successful business transformation and become skilled in the strongest platform to meet all of our customer’s needs.


This role has been designated as a remote position, allowing qualified talent throughout the listed country to be considered for the opportunity.




WHAT YOU WILL DO

After an initial training period, a Lead Data Migration Consultant will be expected to:


  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of Syniti’s Data Migration methodology.
  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in Syniti’s tools, working to prescribed development standards.
  • Good understanding of business processes for one or more assigned functional area, and the ability to quickly learn about new areas.
  • Effectively manage a small team of data migration consultants, to meet assigned responsibilities against the overall project plan.
  • Demonstrate a strong knowledge of underlying technical data structures and definitions of assigned functional process area.
  • Develop data migration rules and reports in the Syniti’s tools as per supplied specification.
  • Evaluate and contribute to ongoing data migration design for assigned process area through data analysis, reporting and collaboration with on-site Syniti and client colleagues.
  • Create and maintain data load programs.
  • Maintain related documentation and clearly communicate status to Syniti Team Leadership and customer PMO.
  • Execution of end-to-end data loads and reconciliations.
  • Support and mentor junior colleagues.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Degree level qualification in Computer Science (or other technology related field).
  • Experience in ETL / Data Migration / Data Quality / Data Analysis.
  • Experience managing resources to deliver a collective goal/responsibility.
  • Functional ERP experience.
  • Project experience across multiple ERP implementations.
  • Database experience - SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Customer facing skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel according to project requirements up to 100%.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Autonomy and Trust: Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, with minimal micromanagement.
  • Growth Opportunities: We are growing rapidly, offering you the chance to grow with us, shape our journey, and share in our success story.
  • Collaborative Support: We value collaboration and support each other, ensuring you won't stand alone in your endeavors.
  • Diversity of Stories: Genuine interest in your unique story and journey. We celebrate individual achievements and want to hear everyone's story.
  • Recognition: We appreciate and celebrate individual achievements, acknowledging the contribution of each team member.
  • Open Organization: We embrace an open and inclusive culture, where hierarchies are minimized, and access is ensured across the board. Everyone is valued, and ideas are welcomed.

Job Title: Senior Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer

We are seeking an experienced Base24 / Base24 Classic Developer to support payment switch development, enhancement, and operational stability within a high-volume card transaction environment. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience working with Tandem/HP NonStop systems , Base24 modules, issuer/acquirer interfaces, and ATM/POS transaction processing flows.

The developer will work closely with cross-functional teams including Product, Application Support, Network Security, and Environment Infrastructure.

  • Analyze and resolve production issues with strong ownership of incident/problem resolution .
  • Implement code enhancements, patches, and release changes in alignment with governance and compliance standards.
  • Design and execute system integration testing, regression testing, and certification testing with network partners (Visa/Mastercard).
  • Work with cross-functional teams to support performance tuning, batch processing, and environment stability.
  • Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient handling of financial transaction data.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed technical documentation, release notes, and operational runbooks .

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years hands-on experience with Base24 or Base24 Classic .
  • Strong technical expertise in:
  • HP NonStop / Tandem (Guardian, OSS)
  • Pathway, TAL, COBOL, SCOBOL, C, TACL, DDL, SQL/Enscribe
  • ATM and POS network protocols
  • ISO 8583 message formats
  • Experience supporting high-availability, transaction-intensive payment switching platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning in a production environment.
  • Knowledge of Visa/Mastercard authorization and clearing , card bin tables, key exchange, PIN translation.
  • Experience in incident management, change control, and release management .

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Base24-eps migration or development.
  • Experience working with Fiserv, First Data, TSYS, ACI Postilion, or Opus environments.
  • Knowledge of EMV, HSM (Thales / SafeNet) , cryptographic key management.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Git , and CI/CD toolchains.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent work experience).

Manager, Corporate Development


Easy Payroll Global Limited Ireland and their local affiliate ITOS Brasil LTDA is looking to hire a Manager, Corporate Development, to provide services to companies within the Perseus Group (“Perseus”).


Perseus is an Operating Group of Constellation Software Inc. (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, and located in over 40 offices.


Location: Brazil


The Role:

The services to be provided by the Manager, Corporate Development, encompasses building strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. These relationships will be formed with software company decision makers (e.g. CEOs, VPs of Corporate Development, founders, and/or owners) of software companies, M&A advisors, and private equity/ venture capital professionals. Success in this role is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships that ultimately lead to Perseus’ acquisition of software companies.


The process of initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately making an acquisition typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/ relationships, and high-quality market research are what ultimately generate successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s).
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency.
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals.
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.



Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • At least 3+ years of experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role, or prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail-oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.


Other Requirements:

title: Data Migration Specialist - Brazil
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Data Migration Specialist - Brazil , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract hybrid or remote.


In this role you will:

The Data Migration Specialist is responsible for transitioning and transforming data from legacy systems to new platforms. The specialist will ensure data integrity, security, and accessibility throughout the migration process, thus supporting the organization's strategic initiatives and operational efficiency. The professional will proactively identify and mitigate risks, ensuring a smooth and successful transition with minimal disruption to business operations.


Main Responsibilities:

  • Data Migration and Transformation: Design and implement data migration processes. Develop scripts, ETL processes ( Extract, Transform, Load) and tools for data migration, adapted to the specific requirements of the project. Utilize SQL, data mapping, and transformation techniques to optimize efficiency.
  • Data Integrity and Quality: Ensure data integrity and validation during the migration process. Perform regular audits and validation checks to verify the accuracy and completeness of the migrated data. Oversee user acceptance testing (UAT) and adjust the migration approach as needed.
  • Project and Risk Management: Plan and manage data migration projects, including resource allocation and schedule management. Identify and mitigate the risks associated with data migration, developing proactive strategies to address potential challenges.
  • Compliance and Governance: Ensuring that data migration processes comply with industry standards and regulations. Adhere to organizational policies and procedures.
  • Documentation and Communication: Generate regular progress reports for stakeholders. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all data migration activities, ensuring transparency, accountability, and knowledge sharing.

Essential Requirements (Hard Skills):

  • Experience: Minimum of 8 to 10 years of experience. At least 5 years of experience in data migration and management.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Technical Tools and Skills:
  • Proficiency in SQL and data migration tools like Talend, Informatica .
  • Experience with database management systems (e.g., SQL Server, Oracle ) to manage and migrate data.
  • Proven knowledge and experience in the design and implementation of ETL processes.
  • Advanced English and/or French.

Soft Skills:

  • Problem Solving: Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Communication: Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail.
  • Adaptability: Ability to work independently and in a team.
  • Project Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Differentials (Nice to Have):

  • Education: Master's degree in a related field.
  • Certifications: Certification in data management (e.g., CDMP) or advanced certifications in data migration tools (e.g., Talend, Informatica ).
  • Knowledge: Experience with data migration to the cloud (AWS, Azure ). Familiarity with agile project management methodologies. Knowledge of data security and privacy regulations.

title: Quality Control Lead
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a structured, strict, and technically-minded Head of Quality Assurance who will build and lead one of the most critical operational units in the company.

Scope of responsibility:

  • Management of a team of 30+ remote assistants
  • Quality control of 5,000+ job applications/month (scaling to 10,000+)
  • Direct reporting to the CEO


Context & Challenges

Current situation:

  • 30 assistants submit job applications on behalf of clients
  • Quality is inconsistent—there is no systematic control
  • Many manual review processes → we need automation
  • No structured onboarding for new assistants
  • No clear KPIs or performance-based motivation


What must be built:

Audit the current team

Hire additional assistants

Build a full Quality Assurance system from scratch

Automate quality checks in collaboration with engineering

Implement onboarding, training, and control processes


Key Responsibilities

Build a Quality Assurance system (30%)

First 2 weeks:

  • Audit current assistants
  • Evaluate work quality (accuracy, speed, compliance)
  • Decide who stays, who leaves
  • Create quality criteria and checklists

Ongoing:

  • Implement regular quality audits and spot-checks
  • Establish KPIs (quality, speed, customer satisfaction)
  • Track quality metrics per assistant
  • Identify repeating errors and remove root causes
  • Review difficult cases with the team

Hiring & Onboarding (25%)

Hiring:

  • Design the hiring funnel (screening → test task → interview)
  • Hire new assistants within first 1–2 months
  • Maintain a candidate pipeline (no current churn, but may appear)

Onboarding & training:

  • Build a structured onboarding program (1–2 weeks)
  • Teach systems, standards, and workflows
  • Certify assistants before they start working with clients
  • Create training materials, videos, guides

Automation & Technology (20%)

Work with engineering team:

  • Identify which checks can be automated
  • Create clear requirements and tasks for developers
  • Test and launch automation tools
  • Utilize AI and scripts for monitoring

Automation examples:

  • Automatic validation of application fields
  • Duplicate application detection
  • Performance dashboards and speed tracking
  • Quality alert system
  • Real-time monitoring tools

Team Management (15%)

  • Workload distribution among assistants
  • KPI tracking and performance reviews
  • Escalation handling and issue resolution
  • Motivation and team culture development

People development:

  • Selective 1:1s
  • Coaching low performers
  • Promote top performers into team leads
  • Create internal career paths

Continuous improvement (10%)

  • Identify bottlenecks and improve processes
  • Implement best practices and standardization
  • Maintain operations documentation
  • Work with client complaints, root cause elimination

Requirements

Must-Have:

2+ years managing operational teams

  • Experience managing 20+ employees
  • Built processes from scratch
  • Preferably BPO/outsourcing/call center/EdTech

Strong systems thinking and discipline

  • SOPs, checklists, regulations, compliance
  • Precision and attention to detail
  • Ability to make difficult decisions (terminations, corrective action)

Technical competency

  • Understanding of automation & quality monitoring
  • Ability to write clear requirements for developers
  • Experience with CRM, monitoring dashboards, etc.
  • Nice-to-have: SQL basics, API logic, scripting

Analytical approach

  • Metrics: quality %, speed, productivity, error rate
  • KPI systems and reporting
  • Data-driven decision-making

Experience in hiring & onboarding


Strong Plus:

BPO/outsourcing experience (data entry, support, back office)

Quality automation experience

Technical degree (engineering / CS / math)

Six Sigma/Lean/Kaizen knowledge

Experience scaling teams from 10 → 50+

QA/Quality Management certifications

Experience with distributed remote teams

title: Full Stack Mobile Developer (Flutter, C#/.NET)
description:
Company Description

US based health technology company to be disclosed during the interview process.


Role Description

We are seeking a Full Stack Mobile Developer  to join our team and take ownership of our health monitoring mobile application. This application integrates with a Bluetooth-enabled ring pulse oximeter to collect health data throughout the night. 


The ideal candidate will be a hands-on developer with expertise in both mobile development (Flutter/Dart) and backend technologies (C#/.NET), capable of ensuring seamless device integration, reliable overnight data collection, and robust backend connectivity with Azure services. 


Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and maintenance of cross-platform mobile flagship application using Flutter/Dart for iOS and Android. 
  • Optimize Bluetooth connectivity with the ring pulse oximeter device. 
  • Address mobile battery optimization challenges to guarantee reliable overnight data collection. 
  • Introduce in app features to provide payments, notifications, and support (chat)
  • Manage the release process for both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. 
  • Collaborate with backend developers on Azure-hosted .NET services, contributing to backend development when required. 
  • Ensure compliance with health data security and privacy standards. 
  • Work independently while providing technical leadership within the team. 


Qualifications

  • Advanced English communication skills (C1 level), both written and spoken.
  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with strong expertise in mobile development. 
  • Proven experience with Flutter/Dart  for cross-platform mobile applications. 
  • Working knowledge of C# and .NET , with the ability to contribute to backend services. 
  • Deep understanding of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE)  implementation. 
  • Experience with mobile battery optimization techniques  for background processes. 
  • Successful track record of publishing and maintaining apps in the App Store and Google Play. 
  • Experience integrating with Microsoft Azure services . 
  • Familiarity with Firebase  (Authentication, Crashlytics, Analytics), Sentry , and PostHog . 
  • Familiarity with in-app payment systems (such as Authorize.net, Stripe)
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail. 
  • Prior experience in health or medical app development is a plus.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
About Us

At MetaCTO, we specialize in helping startups and growing companies turn visionary ideas into successful digital products through expert app development and fractional CTO services. As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) , you will play a critical role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of the backend infrastructure that powers innovative applications for our clients. This role will involve managing cloud environments, optimizing databases, automating deployments, and improving system observability.

Job Description

As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at MetaCTO , you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining highly available, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions. You will collaborate with software engineers to improve system performance, automate operations, and ensure the smooth functioning of critical backend services. You’ll work extensively with cloud platforms like AWS, leveraging technologies such as Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines to enhance system reliability.

Responsibilities
  • Architect, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure on AWS (Lambda, EC2, RDS, S3, EKS, SQS, CloudWatch).
  • Manage and optimize databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL ) for performance, reliability, and security.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, and logging solutions to ensure system health and performance, with specific experience using Zabbix and Elastic Logging .
  • Design and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment and scaling of applications.
  • Work with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Develop and enforce security best practices for cloud environments and infrastructure.
  • Automate operational processes using Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) and scripting languages like Python or Bash.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related incidents and optimize system performance.
  • Collaborate with backend engineers to ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and scalable system design, with a strong focus on Django-based applications .
Qualifications
  • 5-10 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or Cloud Engineering roles.
  • Strong expertise in AWS cloud services (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda, CloudFront, EKS, SQS, IAM ).
  • Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes, ECS, or EKS) .
  • Deep knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) , including performance tuning, query optimization, monitoring, and migration management.
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi .
  • Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, or GitLab CI/CD ).
  • Proficiency in monitoring tools , specifically Zabbix , and logging solutions like Elastic Logging .
  • Scripting experience with Python, Bash, or Go for automating operational tasks.
  • Experience working with Django-based applications in a cloud environment.
  • Experience implementing security best practices for cloud-based applications.
  • Knowledge of distributed systems and microservices architecture .
Preferred Skills
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer) are a plus.
  • Experience with serverless computing and event-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with message queue services (SQS, RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Understanding of zero-downtime deployments and disaster recovery strategies.
Position Details
  • Type: Full-Time
  • Location: 100% Remote
  • Hours: US Pacific Time hours
How to Apply

If you are passionate about scalability, automation, and reliability , and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you. Please submit your resume and an optional brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

MetaCTO is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Iteration Video Editor
description:
Who We Are

Mindful Agency is a performance-driven creative team specializing in high-converting Meta ads for top tech brands. We’re looking for an Iterations Editor—someone who can take fully edited 30–60 second Meta ads and generate multiple high-quality variations designed to increase performance, improve hook testing, and expand creative volume.


This role is not standard editing. It requires someone who understands creative iteration as a scientific process: isolating variables, modifying structure and pacing, and generating new variants that give Meta’s algorithm more opportunities to find winners.


What You’ll Do
  • Open existing fully-edited Premiere Pro project files and generate new, distinct iterations of the same ad.
  • Create alternative hooks, shorten or re-structure timelines, adjust pacing, and introduce new punch-in/out moments to increase stopping power.
  • Modify captions, layout, on-screen text, reframing, b-roll timing, and transitions while keeping brand consistency intact.
  • Produce multiple versions of each ad optimized for performance testing (length trims, hook variations, CTA variations).
  • Ensure all variations are export-ready, cleanly organized, and aligned with Mindful Agency’s internal workflow in Notion and Google Drive.
  • Collaborate asynchronously with the creative team to understand each ad’s strategic goal (problem-solution, testimonial, UGC pacing, value prop emphasis).
  • Maintain consistent daily output based on clear production expectations and deliverables.


Requirements
  • Expert-level proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro (must be comfortable navigating another editor’s timeline, proxies, nests, captions, and media management).
  • Strong understanding of direct-response video editing, ideally with experience in Meta/TikTok ad formats.
  • Ability to identify and modify high-leverage creative variables: hook strength, pacing, text placement, dynamic framing, and overall watch-through optimization.
  • Strong creative instincts paired with a scientific mindset—able to think in terms of tests, variants, and performance hypotheses.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to produce clean, organized sequences that integrate back into our workflow.
  • Fast, reliable communication and ability to work independently across global time zones.
  • Portfolio demonstrating short-form ads or UGC-style edits (required).


Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience with direct-response brands, SaaS, tech, or e-commerce.
  • Familiarity with Meta ad performance patterns (retention curves, thumb-stop theory, hook testing).
  • Motion graphics or caption stylization skills for added variation when needed.


Why Work With Mindful

  • Clear workflows, predictable task structure, and objective editing metrics.
  • Long-term opportunity with consistent volume of work.

title: Lead WordPress Developer
description:
Given that this position requires English proficiency, we are only considering CV's provided in English. Thank you, and we look forward to your submission!


About Olly Olly

Olly Olly is a $25M ARR digital marketing company serving small businesses across the United States. We've built our reputation on transparency, results, and making sophisticated marketing accessible to business owners who need to focus on running their companies, not learning marketing complexities. As we scale our platform and demand generation efforts, we're looking for an exceptional WordPress developer who can lead our landing page creation and optimization function.


The Role

We're seeking a battle-tested WordPress Developer & Landing Page Team Lead who has personally managed the technical execution of high-stakes marketing campaigns with millions of dollars in ad spend. This isn't a role for someone who's built a few landing pages—we need someone who has been THE person responsible for ensuring every pixel fires correctly, every form submits properly, and every dollar of ad spend has a clear path to conversion tracking.


You'll lead a team of two WordPress developers, managing multiple concurrent projects while maintaining the exacting standards required when significant marketing budgets are on the line. You'll be the technical bridge between our marketing campaigns (primarily Meta, but across various channels) and our HubSpot CRM, ensuring flawless data flow and attribution tracking.


Core Responsibilities

Landing Page Development & Campaign Execution

  • Design, build, and deploy high-converting landing pages optimized for paid traffic from Meta, Google, and other advertising platforms
  • Own the complete technical implementation of marketing campaigns from concept through launch
  • Ensure pixel-perfect tracking setup across all campaigns, including Meta Pixel, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, and retargeting audiences
  • Implement and troubleshoot complex tracking scenarios including server-side tracking, UTM parameters, and multi-touch attribution
  • Optimize landing page performance for speed, mobile responsiveness, and conversion rates
  • Conduct A/B testing and implement rapid iterations based on campaign performance data


HubSpot Integration & Data Management

  • Build and maintain seamless integrations between landing pages and HubSpot CRM
  • Ensure accurate lead capture, form submissions, and data synchronization
  • Implement and validate proper lead source attribution and campaign tracking in HubSpot
  • Create custom workflows and automations to support campaign objectives
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies and ensure marketing attribution accuracy


Technical Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and mentor a team of two WordPress developers
  • Manage workload distribution across multiple concurrent projects and campaigns
  • Establish and enforce development standards, quality assurance protocols, and best practices
  • Conduct code reviews and provide constructive technical feedback
  • Create project timelines and ensure on-time delivery of campaign assets
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex technical challenges


Quality Assurance & Risk Management

  • Implement rigorous QA processes, before any campaign launch.
  • Verify all tracking mechanisms are functioning correctly across devices and browsers
  • Maintain detailed documentation of tracking implementations and technical specifications
  • Proactively identify and resolve potential issues before they impact campaign performance
  • Ensure compliance with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in all tracking implementations


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional WordPress development experience
  • Direct experience managing technical execution of marketing campaigns with $1M+ in total ad spend
  • Must have been the PRIMARY person responsible for landing page build and campaign launch (not just a contributor on a larger team)
  • Portfolio demonstrating high-converting landing pages you've personally built and deployed


Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience implementing Git-based version control (GitLab, GitHub, or Bitbucket) and configuring Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for WordPress. Must be proficient in automating deployment across environments (Dev, Staging, Prod) and integrating unit and end-to-end tests into the workflow.
  • Expert-level WordPress development skills including ACF. Gutenberg, custom theme development, plugin customization, and advanced page builders (Elementor, Divi, or similar)
  • Deep understanding of Meta Business Suite, Meta Pixel implementation, and Conversions API
  • Proven experience with HubSpot CRM integration, forms, and tracking implementation
  • Strong command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript/jQuery, and PHP
  • Experience with VueJS is a plus
  • Experience with conversion tracking pixels across multiple platforms (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Google Tag Manager and server-side tracking implementations
  • Understanding of marketing analytics, attribution models, and conversion optimization principles


Management & Communication

  • Demonstrated experience leading and mentoring developers
  • Exceptional project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple high-priority projects
  • Clear communication style with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Comfortable with accountability when significant marketing budgets are at stake
  • Ability to explain complex technical concepts to marketing team members


Performance Standards

  • Meticulous attention to detail—one misconfigured pixel can cost thousands in wasted ad spend
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet tight campaign launch deadlines
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues before they become problems
  • Commitment to continuous learning as platforms and tracking methods evolve


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with marketing automation platforms beyond HubSpot (Marketo, Pardot, ActiveCampaign)
  • Familiarity with conversion rate optimization (CRO) methodologies and tools
  • Knowledge of SQL for custom reporting and data analysis
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms (VWO, Optimizely, Google Optimize)
  • Understanding of SEO best practices for landing pages
  • Certifications in Meta Blueprint, Google Analytics, or HubSpot
  • Experience in agency or fast-paced startup environments


What Success Looks Like

First 30 Days

  • Audit current landing page infrastructure and tracking implementations
  • Meet with marketing team to understand campaign objectives and conversion goals
  • Review existing team workflows and identify optimization opportunities
  • Successfully launch first campaign under your management with zero tracking issues

First 90 Days

  • Establish standardized QA protocols and documentation for all campaign launches
  • Implement improvements to team efficiency and project management processes
  • Build trust with marketing team through flawless technical execution
  • Identify and resolve any lingering tracking or integration issues

First Year

  • Lead team through successful execution of major product launch campaigns
  • Demonstrably improve landing page conversion rates through testing and optimization
  • Establish Olly Olly's landing page function as a competitive advantage
  • Develop your team members' skills and create succession planning


Why This Role Matters

When we invest in marketing campaigns, every dollar needs to count. You'll be the person ensuring that our tracking is accurate, our data is clean, and our ability to optimize is never compromised by technical issues. Your work directly impacts our ability to scale profitably and serve more small business owners.


Compensation & Benefits

Competitive salary commensurate with experience, plus comprehensive benefits package. This is a full-time remote position, though you'll be working closely with team members across time zones.


Our Culture

We value directness, authenticity, and results over politics or polish. We're building something meaningful for small business owners who are often underserved by the marketing industry. We expect excellence but also recognize that real growth happens when people are supported, challenged, and given autonomy to do their best work.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations

  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

Monitorar performance e escalabilidade, otimizando queries e serviços. 5. DevOps e CI/CD Automatizar deploys utilizando Docker, Kubernetes, ECS/Fargate ou EKS. Configurar pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins). 6. Colaboração e Melhoria Contínua Trabalhar em equipe, revisando códigos (Code Review) e propondo melhorias. title: SAP Automation Developer QA/Tester
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for SAP Automation Developer QA/Tester who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

Work as part of SAP Empowered Product Teams, design, develop, and execute test concepts, automated or manual test script for cross platform mobile app SAP Service and Asset Manager and foundation framework Mobile Development Kit for Windows.

Follow SAP’s software quality standard, efficient use of standard and SAP mobile technology in automation development and testing for mobile applications, such as SAP BTP Mobile Services, SAP Mobile Development Kit, ilodata, SQL, Ultralite DB, Appium, with Behavior Driven Development, Java, JMeter, OData Services, SAP Gateway, S/4HANA system, Jenkins etc.

Actively collaborate with product manager to clarify on customer problem, feature requirement

Actively collaborate with UX designers to clarify UI Figma design requirement for each platform, iOS, Android and Windows.

Document test concept, automation processes, test cases and workflows for reference and future improvement.

Actively collaborate with backend integration service developers to clarify OData Service features and requirement, to ensure sufficient test coverage.

Use S/4HANA system and its relevant business processes (Plant Maintenance, Quality Management, Material Management, Inventory Management, Extended Warehouse Management, Work Clearance Management etc), and data objects (Work Order, Notification, PM Confirmation, Timesheet, Service Order, Service Confirmation, Service Quotation, Equipment, Functional Location, Material Master etc), setup necessary test data in S/4HANA system, perform end-to-end test, and validate developed features against S/4HANA system.

Conduct thorough testing, with strong focus on usability, user experience, security, performance and feature correctness. Actively collaborate with frontend and backend developers to report functional issues, crashes, and performance problems, and validate fixes and resolution as required. Ensure test plant and results are maintained in the central Global Test Platform system for reporting and traceability.

Provide sufficient documentations on test environment, test results, re-produce steps

Collaborate with user assistance developer (technical writer) on any product documentation issues

Follow agile development principles and best practice during development

Participate in daily scrums

Maintain communication and documentation in English. Maintain proper communication and notification with SAP development manager on vacation or absence to ensure minimum impact to development timeline

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (C#/.NET/React.js)
description:

You'll collaborate with Senior and Staff engineers across North and South America, owning features from concept through production support and seeing users benefit almost immediately. If delivering practical solutions quickly and refining them in live environments motivates you, you'll fit right in.

Their solution enhances brand loyalty through improved customer experiences, optimizes operations to result in lower costs, and boosts sales volumes through comprehensive analytics and employee performance insights.   • Excellent written and spoken English; must be able to discuss trade-offs with teammates and stakeholders
  • 7+ years professional C#/.NET (Core and Framework) experience - recent in the last 2 years
  • Modern JavaScript framework experience, preferably React.js (Vue.js, OR Angular) - delivering new features, not just fixing bugs
  • Comfortable working end-to-end (UI, API, data layer, infra scripts); whatever it takes
  • Must have "ownership mindset" - you'll have the responsibility of designing, building, shipping, monitoring, and fixing the features you touch
  • Fluent in Git and modern branching / PR workflows
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks
  • Team first approach displaying transparency, reliability, decisiveness, and a laser focus on customer impact
  • Rapid learner as you're expected to ramp up on a new library or API in hours, not weeks

title: Customer Success Manager
description:

Marketing Ninjas is a cutting-edge marketing agency specializing in helping restoration companies gain more referral partners and secure exclusive leads. As a faith-driven and ninja-themed company, we operate with the highest standards, integrity, and a commitment to excellence. Our mission is to empower our clients with the tools and strategies they need to grow their businesses successfully.


Job Overview

We’re looking for a Client Success Manager (CSM) who is passionate about building relationships, ensuring client satisfaction, and driving results. The CSM will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they see maximum value from our services and continue to grow with us. This role requires exceptional communication skills, a strong command of English with minimal accent , and a proactive approach to client engagement.


Key Responsibilities

  • Client Onboarding & Relationship Management: Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and positive experience.
  • Ongoing Support & Strategy: Regularly check in with clients to review performance, provide strategic insights, and optimize their marketing campaigns.
  • Retention & Growth: Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services to help clients scale their businesses.
  • Issue Resolution: Address client concerns promptly and professionally, working with internal teams to resolve any challenges.
  • Training & Education: Educate clients on best practices for using our Marketing Ninjas Lead Engine , powered by GoHighLevel .
  • Performance Monitoring: Track client success metrics and proactively reach out to offer guidance and improvements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our sales, marketing, and fulfillment teams using Slack, ClickUp, and GoHighLevel to ensure a seamless client experience.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 2+ years in a client success, account management, or customer service role (preferably in digital marketing, SaaS, or home services industries).
  • Communication Skills:Fluent English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimal accent for clear and effective communication with U.S.-based clients.
  • Tech-Savvy: Experience using GoHighLevel, Slack, and ClickUp (or similar CRM and project management tools).
  • Comfortable with marketing automation and CRM tools.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically and proactively address client concerns.
  • Results-Driven: Passionate about helping clients succeed and achieving high retention rates.
  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple clients and tasks efficiently.
  • Faith & Integrity: A commitment to conducting business with the highest ethical standards.


Why Join Marketing Ninjas?

  • Work with a mission-driven team that operates with integrity and excellence.
  • Remote work flexibility – work from anywhere!
  • Opportunities for growth in a fast-paced, ninja-themed marketing agency.
  • Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on faith, values, and client success.


Ready to Join the Ninja Squad?

If you’re passionate about helping businesses grow , building strong client relationships , and delivering exceptional service , we’d love to hear from you! Apply today and become part of the Marketing Ninjas team.

title: Desenvolvedor de front-end - Shopify
description:
Buscamos um desenvolvedor Shopify. A posição é remota e o fuso horário deve estar alinhado com o de Pittsburgh (EUA) .


Responsabilidades:

1. Reescrita do Storefront em Hydrogen

  • Reconstruir e aprimorar a vitrine Shopify existente da Industrial Powder usando Hydrogen 2.0 e a Shopify Storefront GraphQL API .
  • Replicar e melhorar o conjunto de recursos atual:
  • Páginas de detalhes de produtos
  • Diferenciação entre produtos sob encomenda, em estoque, painéis, tambores e pequenos lotes
  • Coleções com filtragem
  • Lógica de preços específica para B2B
  • Descontos, comportamento do carrinho e integração de checkout
  • Gerenciamento de contas de clientes
  • Pesquisa, navegação e acessibilidade
  • Layout responsivo com foco em dispositivos móveis


2. Biblioteca de Componentes Reutilizáveis

  • Criar uma biblioteca de componentes de interface (UI) baseada em React , seguindo o sistema de design PPG Primer :
  • Reconstruir componentes principais (botões, cabeçalhos, banners, modais, tabelas etc.) para React, usando os tokens de design existentes (atualmente uma biblioteca de componentes em .NET)
  • Garantir acessibilidade, responsividade e personalização
  • Fornecer documentação e exemplos ao vivo usando o Storybook
  • Entregar como um submódulo Git ou pacote privado NPM


3. Framework de Configuração de Lançamento Rápido

  • Entregar um modelo inicial (Starter Template) em Hydrogen para futuras vitrines:
  • Modelos de configuração de ambiente
  • Suporte para substituição de temas conforme a marca de cada região
  • Roteamento, localização e configuração de CI/CD pré-configurados
  • Estrutura de pastas escalável e alternância entre regiões


4. Integração com o CMS Kontent.ai

  • Integrar o Kontent.ai como CMS para todo o conteúdo não relacionado a produtos:
  • Utilizar as APIs GraphQL ou REST do Kontent.ai para entregar conteúdo aos componentes Hydrogen
  • Implementar blocos de conteúdo modulares gerenciados pelo CMS (Hero, Banner Promocional, Depoimentos, FAQs etc.)
  • Habilitar layouts de página dinâmicos e páginas de marketing (ex.: /sobre-nos, /sustentabilidade)
  • Integração no nível de rotas: permitir que o CMS controle navegação e estrutura de layout
  • Suporte a campos de conteúdo localizados para vitrines multilíngues e multi-regiões
  • Implementar funcionalidade de pré-visualização segura para revisar atualizações de conteúdo em ambiente de testes
  • Colaborar com os responsáveis pelo conteúdo para definir e implementar modelos e fluxos de trabalho dentro do Kontent.ai

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Job Title: Business Development Manager – Sustainability

Location: Brazil- Remote

Employment Type: Full-time


About the Role

BSI is seeking an experienced and strategic Business Development Manager (BDM), Sustainability to maintain and grow relationships with large, strategically important clients. You will coordinate BSI’s global efforts to deliver assurance solutions focused on sustainability, greenhouse gas (GHG) verification, reduction, and neutrality.

In this role, you will lead account planning, achieve sales targets by expanding existing accounts and securing new business, and provide thought leadership within the sustainability space. You will also support sales initiatives across the Americas and actively engage in industry events.


In your day to day, you will be responsible for:

  • Achieve assigned sales targets and drive profitable revenue growth.
  • Develop and manage relationships with strategic accounts and senior business leaders.
  • Retain existing accounts through ongoing engagement and partnership with operational teams.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities to expand BSI’s sustainability client base.
  • Negotiate contracts and close deals, integrating requirements into operational delivery.
  • Support other sales professionals in selling sustainability and GHG audit services.
  • Collaborate with global marketing, product development, and sales teams on priorities and initiatives.
  • Participate in industry associations, conferences, and events to provide thought leadership.
  • Conduct account health checks, review pricing annually, and facilitate issue resolution.
  • Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM data to support business planning and customer service.
  • Analyze market conditions, competitors, and customer insights to enhance sales performance.


To be successful in the role, you will have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, quimical engineer or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • At least 5 years of experience in solutions sales and business development.
  • Experience selling assessment or audit solutions within professional services.
  • Proven ability to engage senior-level management and manage multinational client relationships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Salesforce (preferred).
  • Strong skills in communication, persuasion, relationship-building, and performance monitoring.


Career opportunities are vast with around 5,000 employees working with over 82,000 clients in 182 countries. BSI challenges mediocrity and complacency to help embed excellence into the way people and products work. That means showing businesses how to improve performance, reduce risk, and achieve sustainable growth.


What we offer:

BSI offers a competitive total reward package, an independent and varied job in an international environment, flexible working hours, ongoing training and development with the inclusion of 20-days annual leave, bank holidays, medical, dental, vision, and life insurance, short-term and long-term disability, maternal leave, paid parental leave, paid bereavement leave, learning and development opportunities, and a wide range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your lifestyle.


Do you believe the world deserves excellence?

We are proud to be the business improvement company for other organisations to become more sustainable and resilient and finally to inspire trust in their products, systems, services, and the world we live in.


Headquartered in London, BSI is the world's first national standards organization with more than 100 years of experience. We are a global partner for 86,000 companies and organizations in over 193 countries, offering development, auditing, certification, and training services, including innovative software solutions and cyber security expertise for all industries: from aerospace and automotive to food, construction, energy, healthcare, IT and trade sectors. Incorporated by Royal Charter, we’re truly impartial and home to the ultimate mark of trust, the Kitemark.

Through our unique combination of consulting, training, assurance, and regulatory services, we bring solid and broad knowledge to every company.


D&I Policy

BSI is committed to ensuring the diversity of our workforce reflects that of our clients and the communities in which we operate. Our goal is to create a sense of belonging for all employees by providing opportunities to develop, grow, and engage with our global organization, all while having fun doing great work. BSI is a community where everyone can thrive.

If you require any reasonable accommodations to be made on account of a disability or impairment throughout our recruiting process, please inform your Talent Acquisition Partner.

title: Senior Data Administrator
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Data Administrator who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid (with the possibility of 100% remote) , in the city of Londrina.


MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES *

Main Responsibilities

● Data Modeling: Design, develop, and maintain relational and multidimensional data models to meet the requirements of transactional (OLTP) and analytical (OLAP/Data Warehouse) systems.


● Metadata Management: Manage the data catalog, defining business concepts, maintaining data lineage, and ensuring that metadata is clear and accessible.


● Data Quality: Implement and monitor data quality rules, identify anomalies, and collaborate with business and development teams to correct inconsistencies.

● Data Governance: Support the creation, curation, and evolution of best practice guides and standards for data modeling and integration, ensuring compliance with internal policies and regulations such as the LGPD (Brazilian General Data Protection Law).

● Implementation and Curation: Create and curate physical data models in databases, ensuring that the implementation is aligned with the logical design.

● Technical Collaboration: Act as a point of reference for development, BI, and data science teams, offering support and expertise on issues related to data structure and access.


Nice to Have:

● Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) applied to data projects (DataOps).

● Knowledge of other data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation). ● Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), especially with database and data lake services.

● Advanced or fluent English for collaboration with global teams.

● Previous experience in the company's sector (e.g., finance, retail, industry).


JOB REQUIREMENTS


MINIMUM REQUIREMENT FOR THE POSITION * DESIRABLE

Education Experience

Minimum Education and Experience

● Education: Completed and proven higher education in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or related fields. Short courses or predominantly online courses will not be considered as primary education.

● Experience: Minimum of 6 years of market experience, working directly with data modeling, administration, and governance.

● Professional Stability: Average of 2 years of tenure in previous jobs, according to resume history. Certifications (Desirable)

● At least one active certification, such as:

○ DAMA Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP) - Associate or Practitioner level.

○ Certification in specific tools (e.g., Informatica, Oracle).


Technical Skills

Technical Skills (Hard Skills)

● Proficiency in relational (3NF) and dimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake) data modeling.

● Proven experience with data modeling tools, preferably Oracle SQL Developer Data Modeler.

● Solid knowledge of Data Governance tools for Catalog, Lineage, and Quality, preferably the Informatica suite (IDMC/Axon/EDC).

● In-depth knowledge of the General Data Protection Law (LGPD) and its application in data architectures.

● Proficiency in SQL for data analysis, manipulation, and validation.


● Knowledge of Data Warehousing, Data Marts, and Business Intelligence concepts. Behavioral Competencies (Soft Skills)

● Analytical Vision: Ability to analyze complex requirements and translate them into effective data solutions.

● Assertive Communication: Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences (technical and business).

● Organization and Focus: Discipline to manage multiple projects and priorities autonomously.

title: Country Manager (Legal, Brasil)
description:
Hello!



We are looking for an experienced and proactive Country Manager to join our global legal team and lead enforcement efforts in Brazil.


You’ll work closely with global legal and business teams, directly protecting the rights of some of the world's most recognized brands.


This is a role with complete ownership for driving our expansion in Brazil.


We need a manager with a legal background who knows how to create processes from scratch in a startup environment, rather than an established corporation. The ideal candidate will effectively lead people, design and scale operations, and be highly results-driven.


Who are we?



BrandMonitor is a global legal-tech company focused on the protection of intellectual property rights across the world. We proudly represent over 450 international brands across industries like fashion, luxury goods, electronics, and more — in their fight against counterfeiting and IP violations.

Our legal operations span Europe, Asia, MENA and Latin America , and we are now expanding our legal team in China .



What you will do:



  • Be responsible for meeting the revenue plan and the target number of enforcement actions (purchases, claims, and lawsuits);
  • Achieve operational profitability for the project;
  • Rebuild the team, organize rapid onboarding, and ensure the team achieves target performance indicators;
  • Develop operational and hiring regulations for project scaling (increasing the number of protected brands, successful cases, and compensation amounts);
  • Negotiate with counterfeit sellers and ensure compliance with settlement agreements and court decisions;
  • Organize regular, predictable seizures of counterfeit goods with law enforcement agencies in the region;
  • Ensure the legality of all activities and provide accurate reporting to the government and the head office.



What we expect from you:


  • Degree in Law / Experience in a management position at a law firm;
  • Project management experience 2-3 years;
  • Experience in building processes from scratch;
  • Knowledge of Intellectual Property - an advantage;
  • Leadership, responsibility, decision-making ability, multitasking skills;
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English B2.



What We Offer


  • Work with top-tier global clients and international teams;
  • Competitive salary;
  • Opportunity to lead and shape legal operations in the region;
  • Remote-first setup with flexibility;
  • Real impact on the global fight against counterfeit trade.
  • We’re building the future of IP protection — fast, smart and global.



Join us at BrandMonitor and help us grow stronger by hiring the people who’ll make it happen.

  • Apoiar projetos de integração entre plataformas cloud e sistemas de BI, propondo soluções técnicas que melhorem o fluxo de dados e a eficiência operacional;
  • Garantir o processamento de dados em ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção, atuando na correção de problemas dentro da plataforma Apache Airflow;

  • Produzir e analisar indicadores de desempenho (BI) utilizando Excel avançado e ferramentas analíticas;
  • Executar outras atividades compatíveis com a função, conforme demanda.



O que buscamos:

  • Experiência comprovada em implantação e suporte de clusters AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service), Azure Storage e outros recursos de nuvem;

  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de redes (VPN, switches, roteamento) e diagnóstico de falhas de conectividade;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle), incluindo consultas complexas e otimização de performance;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Grafana, ou similares) e análise de dados;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de versionamento e automação DevOps (Git, pipelines CI/CD);
  • Experiência em ambientes Linux virtualizados e plataformas de virtualização;
  • Formação superior completa em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Perfil colaborativo, comunicativo e orientado a resultados, com interesse genuíno em crescimento profissional e trabalho em equipe;

title: Instructional Designer
description:
ADP is hiring a Learning Design Consultant (Instructional Designer).


In this role, you will focus primarily on applying efficient and agile design approaches to develop innovative, engaging learning solutions, using ADP learning design standards and tools, to meet the learning needs of ADP associates and clients.


No two days are the same. You will do everything from creating design documents, testing and deploying content, conducting needs assessments across multiple business lines, establishing training plans, overseeing translations, measuring results, and more. You will do this all to the highest standards with an eye on appealing to multi-generational talent and the modern learner and by partnering across the learning organization to apply innovative techniques in instructional design. You can create compelling content and convey ideas and information to many levels of an organization.


To thrive in the role, you have 3+ years of experience in the learning - development field. You have worked independently to design and develop sound training in various modalities, i.e., eLearning, instructor-led, blended, job aids, and more, and can manage simultaneous projects with deadlines. It would be best to be a continuous learner who focuses on personal development and business process improvement to our design standards. Your work will help our businesses support our clients who employ one to millions of employees.


Like what you see? Apply now!


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Innovation : You seek opportunities to apply innovative design thinking to your projects and will work to keep ADP's approach to designing learning up to date with the products and solutions ADP offers its clients.
  • Flexibility and Agility : You can adapt to changing business requirements, projects, and resources and use agile approaches to meet business needs.
  • Design: You'll design holistic solutions engaging team members and business partners in the design process to ensure the solution design is flexible and addresses the unique needs of the learners. Solution design should consider and factor in how the work environment impacts learning.
  • Development: You can develop solutions across a broad set of learning modalities and tools without creating redundant solutions and ensure that continuous learning and performance support concepts are applied.
  • Learning Outcomes: You measure your outcomes and ensure your learning solutions result in the intended business impact.
  • Continuous Learner: You focus on personal development to develop and elevate professional knowledge and skill. You take the same approach to business process improvement to improve ADP learning design standards and drive the adoption of those standards. You maintain an outside-in perspective by building and maintaining peer networks inside and outside ADP.


TO SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE:

A college degree is not required but could set you apart. What's more important is having the skills and experience to do the job. You will need 3+ years of experience in instructional development, adult learning theory, and/or technical writing.

Other things that will set you apart:

  • Experience using eLearning tools such as Captivate, Articulate 360 , Synthesia, TechSmith Camtasia , TechSmith SnagIt, Audacity, and Vyond. Technical aptitude to quickly learn new development tools.
  • Experience using a Learning Management System (i.e., Litmos)
  • Experience with simple Graphic Design


Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in the learning and development field
  • Ability to systematically design, develop, and implement learning content that meets specific organizational needs
  • Skilled in building learning solutions for English-speaking audiences
  • Proficient in Articulate Storyline, Rise, Synthesia, or similar authoring tools
  • Working knowledge of Learning Management Systems (upload/manage content, apply technical standards, etc.)
  • Proven success collaborating virtually


YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE BECAUSE YOU CAN:

  • Collaborate. Courage comes from how associates are willing to have difficult conversations, speak up, be an owner, and respect one another's ideas to find the best solution.
  • Deliver at epic scale. We deliver real user outcomes using strong judgment and good instincts. We're obsessed with the art of achieving simplicity with a focus on client happiness and productivity.
  • Be surrounded by curious learners. We align ourselves with other smart people in an environment where we grow and elevate one another to the next level. We encourage our associates to listen, stay agile, and learn from mistakes.
  • Act like an owner - doer. Mission-driven and committed to navigating change, you will be encouraged to take on any challenge and solve complex problems. No tasks are beneath or too great for us. We are hands-on and willing to master our craft.
  • Give back to others. Always do the right thing for our clients and our community and humbly give back to the community where we live and work. Support our associates in times of need through ADP's Philanthropic Foundation.
  • Join a company committed to equality and equity. Our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions.


Learn more here:

What are you waiting for? Apply now!
